forall([gan-md_, gan-t_, gan-v_, gan-k_], is-annihilating-poly(gan-md_, gan-t_, gan-v_, gan-k_) iff is-monic(scal(gan-md_), gan-k_) and poly-op(gan-md_, gan-t_, gan-k_, gan-v_) = vzero(gan-md_) and forall([ganq_ in carr(poly(scal(gan-md_)))], not(ganq_ = zero(poly(scal(gan-md_)))) implies poly-op(gan-md_, gan-t_, ganq_, gan-v_) = vzero(gan-md_) implies deg(scal(gan-md_), gan-k_) <= deg(scal(gan-md_), ganq_)))

is-antiderivable

forall([phi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) iff forsome([f_], is-antiderivative(f_, phi, a, b)))

is-antiderivative

forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and phi in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x_)) and forall([th_], th_ in rr and a < th_ and th_ < b implies is-diff-at(f, th_, phi(th_))))

is-antisymmetric-op

forall([v, jo], is-antisymmetric-op(v, jo) iff forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (rip(v))(jo(x_), y_) = -(rip(v))(x_, jo(y_))))

is-associative

forall([op, crr], is-associative(op, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], op(op(u, v), w) = op(u, op(v, w))))

is-atom

forall([ca, a], is-atom(ca, a) iff a in ca and not(a = empty-set) and forall([mab_ in ca], mab_ subset a implies not(mab_ = empty-set) implies mab_ = a))

is-baire-continuous

forall([s, f], is-baire-continuous(s, f) iff f in fun(fun(nn, nn), pts(s)) and forall([bcz_ in fun(nn, nn), bce_], pos-rr(bce_) implies forsome([bcn_ in nn], forall([bcw_ in fun(nn, nn)], restrict(bcw_, ord-segment(bcn_)) = restrict(bcz_, ord-segment(bcn_)) implies (dist(s))(f(bcz_), f(bcw_)) <= bce_))))

is-bicharacter

forall([chk_, chw_], is-bicharacter(chk_, chw_) iff chw_ in fun(cartesian(carr(chk_), carr(chk_)), unit-circle) and forall([chy_ in carr(chk_)], is-add-character(chk_, vnb-lambda(chx_, carr(chk_), chw_(chx_, chy_)))) and forall([chy_ in carr(chk_)], is-add-character(chk_, vnb-lambda(chx_, carr(chk_), chw_(chy_, chx_)))))

is-bilinear-bicharacter

forall([chk_, chw_], is-bilinear-bicharacter(chk_, chw_) iff is-bicharacter(chk_, chw_) and forall([cha_ in carr(chk_), chx_ in carr(chk_), chy_ in carr(chk_)], chw_((mul(chk_))(cha_, chx_), chy_) = chw_(chx_, (mul(chk_))(cha_, chy_))))

is-bk-sequence

forall([bss_, bsg_, bsv_], is-bk-sequence(bss_, bsg_, bsv_) iff bsv_ in fun(nn, opens(bss_)) and bsv_(0) = pts(bss_) and forall([bsk_ in nn], iden(bsg_) in bsv_(bsk_) and forall([bsp_ in bsv_(bsk_)], (inv(bsg_))(bsp_) in bsv_(bsk_)) and forall([bsp_ in bsv_(succ(bsk_)), bsq_ in bsv_(succ(bsk_)), bsr_ in bsv_(succ(bsk_))], (opr(bsg_))((opr(bsg_))(bsp_, bsq_), bsr_) in bsv_(bsk_))))

is-bounded-l1-functional

forall([omega, ca, mu, f, cb], is-bounded-l1-functional(omega, ca, mu, f, cb) iff f in fun(l1-set(omega, ca, mu), rr) and cb in rr and 0 <= cb and forall([bfx_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu), bfy_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu)], f(vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, bfx_(sx_) + bfy_(sx_))) = f(bfx_) + f(bfy_)) and forall([bfr_ in rr, bfx_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu)], f(vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, bfr_ * bfx_(sx_))) = bfr_ * f(bfx_)) and forall([bfx_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu)], abs(f(bfx_)) <= cb * integral(omega, ca, mu, abs-fn(omega, bfx_))))

is-bounded-linear-functional

forall([m, f], is-bounded-linear-functional(m, f) iff is-linear-functional(m, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in vec(m)], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))

is-bounded-linear-functional-on

forall([m, s, f], is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) iff is-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in s], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))

is-bounded-metric-space

forall([s], is-bounded-metric-space(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([b in rr], forall([x, y], x in pts(s) implies y in pts(s) implies (dist(s))(x, y) <= b)))

is-bounded-op

forall([bov_, bow_, bot_], is-bounded-op(bov_, bow_, bot_) iff is-linear-op(bov_, bow_, bot_) and forsome([bom_ in rr], 0 <= bom_ and forall([box_ in vec(bov_)], ip-norm(bow_, bot_(box_)) <= bom_ * ip-norm(bov_, box_))))

is-boundedly-equivalent

forall([phi, psi], is-boundedly-equivalent(phi, psi) iff phi in fun(nnreal, nnreal) and psi in fun(nnreal, nnreal) and forsome([bel_, beu_], pos-rr(bel_) and pos-rr(beu_) and forall([ber_ in rr], 0 < ber_ implies bel_ * phi(ber_) <= psi(ber_) and psi(ber_) <= beu_ * phi(ber_))))

is-caratheodory-measurable

forall([omega, mu, es], is-caratheodory-measurable(omega, mu, es) iff es subset omega and forall([a_ in power(omega)], mu(a_) = eplus(mu(intersection(a_, es)), mu(difference(a_, es)))))

is-cauchy-net

forall([m, t, d, x], is-cauchy-net(m, t, d, x) iff is-directed-set(d) and x in fun(pts(d), vec(m)) and forall([cnu_ in opens(t)], vzero(m) in cnu_ implies forsome([cni_ in pts(d)], forall([cnj_ in pts(d)], [cni_, cnj_] in dleq(d) implies forall([cnk_ in pts(d)], [cni_, cnk_] in dleq(d) implies (vadd(m))(x(cnj_), (vneg(m))(x(cnk_))) in cnu_)))))

is-cauchy-seq

forall([s, f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], n <= m and n <= n_ implies (dist(s))(f(m), f(n_)) <= eps))))

is-cc-diff-at

forall([g, a, l], is-cc-diff-at(g, a, l) iff g in fun(rr, cc) and a in rr and l in cc and is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(sv_, rr, real-part(g(sv_))), a, real-part(l)) and is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(sv_, rr, imag-part(g(sv_))), a, imag-part(l)))

is-cc-linear-functional

forall([v, f], is-cc-linear-functional(v, f) iff f in fun(vec(v), cc) and forall([hlx_ in vec(v), hly_ in vec(v)], f((vadd(v))(hlx_, hly_)) = f(hlx_) + f(hly_)) and forall([hlc_ in cc, hlx_ in vec(v)], f((act(v))(hlc_, hlx_)) = hlc_ * f(hlx_)))

is-cc-linear-on

forall([baa_, baf_], is-cc-linear-on(baa_, baf_) iff baf_ in fun(vec(baa_), cc) and forall([bax_ in vec(baa_), bay_ in vec(baa_)], baf_((vadd(baa_))(bax_, bay_)) = baf_(bax_) + baf_(bay_)) and forall([baz_ in cc, bax_ in vec(baa_)], baf_((act(baa_))(baz_, bax_)) = baz_ * baf_(bax_)))

is-cc-module-over

forall([aa, vv], is-cc-module-over(aa, vv) iff vv subset cc and 0 in vv and forall([amx_ in vv, amy_ in vv], amx_ + amy_ in vv) and forall([amx_ in vv], -amx_ in vv) and forall([ama_ in aa, amx_ in vv], ama_ * amx_ in vv))

is-cc-space-dim-le

forall([kk, vv, n], is-cc-space-dim-le(kk, vv, n) iff is-cc-module-over(kk, vv) and forsome([amn_ in nn], amn_ <= n and forsome([amg_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), vv)], forall([amv_ in vv], forsome([amb_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), kk)], amv_ = cc-lincomb(amn_, amb_, amg_))))))

is-cc-subring

forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) iff kk subset cc and 0 in kk and 1 in kk and forall([psu_ in kk, psv_ in kk], psu_ + psv_ in kk) and forall([psu_ in kk, psv_ in kk], psu_ * psv_ in kk))

is-ccont-star-subalgebra

forall([rst_, rsa_], is-ccont-star-subalgebra(rst_, rsa_) iff forall([csf_ in rsa_], csf_ in fun(pts(rst_), cc) and is-hom-top-space(rst_, metric-top(cc-ms), csf_)) and forall([csc_ in cc], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), csc_) in rsa_) and forall([csf_ in rsa_, csg_ in rsa_], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), csf_(rsz_) + csg_(rsz_)) in rsa_) and forall([csf_ in rsa_, csg_ in rsa_], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), csf_(rsz_) * csg_(rsz_)) in rsa_) and forall([csf_ in rsa_], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), conjugate(csf_(rsz_))) in rsa_))

is-chain

forall([grd, porel, ch], is-chain(grd, porel, ch) iff ch subset grd and forall([x in ch, y in ch], [x, y] in porel or [y, x] in porel))

is-closable-graph

forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-closable-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff is-functional-graph(ubv_, graph-closure(ubv_, ubg_)))

is-closed

forall([s, a], is-closed(s, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and a subset pts(s) and is-open(s, complement-in(pts(s), a)))

is-closed-form

forall([ubv_, ubd_, ubf_], is-closed-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) iff is-positive-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) and forall([ubq_ in fun(nn, ubd_), ubx_], converges-to(ip-metric-space(ubv_), ubq_, ubx_) implies forall([ube_], pos-rr(ube_) implies forsome([ubn_ in nn], forall([ubm_ in nn, ubk_ in nn], ubn_ <= ubm_ implies ubn_ <= ubk_ implies magnitude(ubf_((vadd(ubv_))(ubq_(ubm_), (vneg(ubv_))(ubq_(ubk_))), (vadd(ubv_))(ubq_(ubm_), (vneg(ubv_))(ubq_(ubk_))))) <= ube_))) implies ubx_ in ubd_ and forall([ube_], pos-rr(ube_) implies forsome([ubn_ in nn], forall([ubm_ in nn], ubn_ <= ubm_ implies magnitude(ubf_((vadd(ubv_))(ubq_(ubm_), (vneg(ubv_))(ubx_)), (vadd(ubv_))(ubq_(ubm_), (vneg(ubv_))(ubx_)))) <= ube_)))))

is-closed-graph

forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-closed-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff is-closed(ip-metric-space(hsum(ubv_, ubv_)), ubg_))

is-closed-star-subalgebra-set

forall([b2va_, b2vs_], is-closed-star-subalgebra-set(b2va_, b2vs_) iff b2vs_ subset vec(b2va_) and vone(b2va_) in b2vs_ and forall([b2vx_ in b2vs_, b2vy_ in b2vs_], (vadd(b2va_))(b2vx_, b2vy_) in b2vs_) and forall([b2vz_ in cc, b2vx_ in b2vs_], (act(b2va_))(b2vz_, b2vx_) in b2vs_) and forall([b2vx_ in b2vs_, b2vy_ in b2vs_], (vmul(b2va_))(b2vx_, b2vy_) in b2vs_) and forall([b2vx_ in b2vs_], (vstar(b2va_))(b2vx_) in b2vs_) and forall([b2vy_ in vec(b2va_)], forall([b2ve_], pos-rr(b2ve_) implies forsome([b2vx_ in b2vs_], (vnrm(b2va_))((vadd(b2va_))(b2vy_, (vneg(b2va_))(b2vx_))) < b2ve_)) implies b2vy_ in b2vs_))

is-cmod-norm

forall([cnm_, cnf_], is-cmod-norm(cnm_, cnf_) iff cnf_ in fun(vec(cnm_), rr) and forall([cnx_ in vec(cnm_)], 0 <= cnf_(cnx_)) and forall([cnx_ in vec(cnm_)], cnf_(cnx_) = 0 iff cnx_ = vzero(cnm_)) and forall([cnc_ in cc, cnx_ in vec(cnm_)], cnf_((act(cnm_))(cnc_, cnx_)) = magnitude(cnc_) * cnf_(cnx_)) and forall([cnx_ in vec(cnm_), cny_ in vec(cnm_)], cnf_((vadd(cnm_))(cnx_, cny_)) <= cnf_(cnx_) + cnf_(cny_)))

is-cnvs-bounded-op

forall([cbv_, cbw_, cbt_], is-cnvs-bounded-op(cbv_, cbw_, cbt_) iff is-cnvs-linear-op(cbv_, cbw_, cbt_) and forsome([cbm_ in rr], 0 <= cbm_ and forall([cbx_ in vec(cbv_)], (vnrm(cbw_))(cbt_(cbx_)) <= cbm_ * (vnrm(cbv_))(cbx_))))

is-cnvs-linear-op

forall([cbv_, cbw_, cbt_], is-cnvs-linear-op(cbv_, cbw_, cbt_) iff cbt_ in fun(vec(cbv_), vec(cbw_)) and forall([cbx_ in vec(cbv_), cby_ in vec(cbv_)], cbt_((vadd(cbv_))(cbx_, cby_)) = (vadd(cbw_))(cbt_(cbx_), cbt_(cby_))) and forall([cbc_ in cc, cbx_ in vec(cbv_)], cbt_((cact(cbv_))(cbc_, cbx_)) = (cact(cbw_))(cbc_, cbt_(cbx_))))

is-cofinal-monotone

forall([e, d, h], is-cofinal-monotone(e, d, h) iff h in fun(pts(e), pts(d)) and forall([cmi_ in pts(e), cmj_ in pts(e)], [cmi_, cmj_] in dleq(e) implies [h(cmi_), h(cmj_)] in dleq(d)) and forall([cmk_ in pts(d)], forsome([cml_ in pts(e)], [cmk_, h(cml_)] in dleq(d))))

is-column-step

forall([r, m, n, b], is-column-step(r, m, n, b) iff forall([csi_ in interval(1, m), csj_ in interval(1, n)], csi_ < csj_ implies entry(b, csi_, csj_) = zero(r)) and forall([csi_ in interval(1, m)], csi_ in interval(1, n) implies entry(b, csi_, csi_) = zero(r) or entry(b, csi_, csi_) = one(r)))

is-commutative

forall([op, crr], is-commutative(op, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr], op(u, v) = op(v, u)))

is-compact

forall([s], is-compact(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forall([c in set], is-open-cover(s, c) implies forsome([f in set], f subset c and card(f) in nn and is-open-cover(s, f))))

is-compact-exhaustion

forall([ces_, cek_], is-compact-exhaustion(ces_, cek_) iff is-metric-space(ces_) and cek_ in fun(nn, power(pts(ces_))) and forall([cen_ in nn], is-compact(subspace-ms(ces_, cek_(cen_)))) and forall([cen_ in nn], forsome([cer_], pos-rr(cer_) and forall([cey_ in cek_(cen_)], ball(ces_, cey_, cer_) subset cek_(cen_ + 1)))) and forall([cex_ in pts(ces_)], forsome([cen_ in nn], cex_ in cek_(cen_))) and forall([cea_], cea_ subset pts(ces_) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(ces_, cea_)) implies forsome([cen_ in nn], cea_ subset cek_(cen_))))

is-compact-nv-domain

forall([cwk_, cwa_], is-compact-nv-domain(cwk_, cwa_) iff is-nv-domain(cwk_, cwa_) and is-compact(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cwk_), cwa_)))

is-compact-op

forall([kqv_, kqw_, kqt_], is-compact-op(kqv_, kqw_, kqt_) iff kqt_ in bounded-ops(kqv_, kqw_) and forall([kqf_ in fun(nn, vec(kqv_))], forall([kqn_ in nn], ip-norm(kqv_, kqf_(kqn_)) <= 1) implies forsome([kqp_], strictly-mono-nn(kqp_) and forsome([kql_], converges-to(ip-metric-space(kqw_), vnb-lambda(kqn_, nn, kqt_(kqf_(kqp_(kqn_)))), kql_)))))

is-compact-t

forall([s], is-compact-t(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forall([c], forall([u in c], u in opens(s)) implies big-union(u, c, u) == pts(s) implies forsome([f], f subset c and card(f) in nn and big-union(u, f, u) == pts(s))))

is-complete

forall([s], is-complete(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forall([f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) implies converges(s, f)))

is-complete-measure

forall([omega, ca, mu], is-complete-measure(omega, ca, mu) iff is-measure(omega, ca, mu) and forall([nls_], is-null-set(omega, ca, mu, nls_) implies nls_ in ca))

is-complete-nv-domain

forall([c2k_, c2a_], is-complete-nv-domain(c2k_, c2a_) iff is-nv-domain(c2k_, c2a_) and is-complete(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(c2k_), c2a_)))

is-complete-subset

forall([m, t, a], is-complete-subset(m, t, a) iff a subset vec(m) and forall([csd_, csx_], is-cauchy-net(m, t, csd_, csx_) implies forall([csi_ in pts(csd_)], csx_(csi_) in a) implies forsome([csl_ in a], net-converges-to(t, csd_, csx_, csl_))))

is-complex-measurable-fn

forall([omega, ca, u], is-complex-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u) iff u in fun(omega, cc) and is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, vnb-lambda(crx_, omega, real-part(u(crx_)))) and is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, vnb-lambda(crx_, omega, imag-part(u(crx_)))))

is-complex-measure

forall([omega, ca, nu], is-complex-measure(omega, ca, nu) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and nu in fun(ca, cc) and forsome([cm1_, cm2_, cm3_, cm4_], is-finite-measure(omega, ca, cm1_) and is-finite-measure(omega, ca, cm2_) and is-finite-measure(omega, ca, cm3_) and is-finite-measure(omega, ca, cm4_) and forall([cma_ in ca], nu(cma_) = cm1_(cma_) - cm2_(cma_) + 1i * (cm3_(cma_) - cm4_(cma_)))))

is-complex-null-set

forall([omega, ca, nu, a], is-complex-null-set(omega, ca, nu, a) iff a in ca and forall([cnb_ in ca], cnb_ subset a implies nu(cnb_) = 0))

is-concat-trace

forall([sasp_, sas_], is-concat-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sal_ in tuples(msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_)))], length(sas_) = succ(length(sal_)) and forall([sai_ in nn], 1 <= sai_ implies sai_ <= length(sal_) implies nth(sai_, sas_) = [received, nth(sai_, sal_)]) and nth(succ(length(sal_)), sas_) = [sent, lst(sal_)]))

is-connected

forall([cns_, cna_], is-connected(cns_, cna_) iff is-metric-space(cns_) and cna_ subset pts(cns_) and forall([cnu_], is-open(cns_, cnu_) implies forall([cnv_], is-open(cns_, cnv_) implies cna_ subset union(cnu_, cnv_) implies forall([cnx_ in cna_], not(cnx_ in cnu_ and cnx_ in cnv_)) implies forsome([cnx_ in cna_], cnx_ in cnu_) implies not(forsome([cnx_ in cna_], cnx_ in cnv_)))))

is-connected-t

forall([cts_, cta_], is-connected-t(cts_, cta_) iff cta_ subset pts(cts_) and forall([ctu_ in opens(cts_), ctv_ in opens(cts_)], cta_ subset union(ctu_, ctv_) implies forall([ctx_ in cta_], not(ctx_ in ctu_ and ctx_ in ctv_)) implies forsome([ctx_ in cta_], ctx_ in ctu_) implies not(forsome([ctx_ in cta_], ctx_ in ctv_))))

is-cont-lin

forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], is-cont-lin(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) iff is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) and forall([seq in fun(nn, vec(m1)), lim in vec(m1)], fr-conv(m1, fam1, seq, lim) implies fr-conv(m2, fam2, vnb-lambda(i, nn, tt(seq(i))), tt(lim))))

is-continuous

forall([s, t, f], is-continuous(s, t, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([a in pts(s)], is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a)))

is-continuous-at

forall([s, t, f, a], is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and a in pts(s) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([delta], pos-rr(delta) and forall([b in pts(s)], (dist(s))(a, b) <= delta implies (dist(t))(f(a), f(b)) <= eps))))

is-continuous-on

forall([f, d], is-continuous-on(f, d) iff f in fun(d, rr) and forall([icp_ in d], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, d), rr-ms, f, icp_)))

is-conull

forall([omega, ca, mu, cs], is-conull(omega, ca, mu, cs) iff cs in ca and mu(complement-in(omega, cs)) = 0)

is-convex-cc

forall([cvu_], is-convex-cc(cvu_) iff cvu_ subset cc and forall([cvx_ in cvu_, cvy_ in cvu_, cvt_ in ccint(0, 1)], cvx_ + cvt_ * (cvy_ - cvx_) in cvu_))

is-convex-functional

forall([m, p], is-convex-functional(m, p) iff p in fun(vec(m), rr) and forall([cfx_ in vec(m)], 0 <= p(cfx_)) and forall([cfx_ in vec(m), cfy_ in vec(m), cft_ in rr], 0 <= cft_ implies cft_ <= 1 implies p((vadd(m))((act(m))(cft_, cfx_), (act(m))(1 - cft_, cfy_))) <= cft_ * p(cfx_) + (1 - cft_) * p(cfy_)))

is-convex-rr

forall([cvra_], is-convex-rr(cvra_) iff cvra_ subset rr and forall([cvrx_ in cvra_, cvry_ in cvra_, cvrt_ in ccint(0, 1)], cvrx_ + cvrt_ * (cvry_ - cvrx_) in cvra_))

is-convex-subset

forall([v, cs], is-convex-subset(v, cs) iff cs subset vec(v) and forall([sxa_ in cs, sxb_ in cs, sxt_ in rr], 0 <= sxt_ implies sxt_ <= 1 implies (vadd(v))((act(v))(1 - sxt_, sxa_), (act(v))(sxt_, sxb_)) in cs))

is-countable

forall([rpc_], is-countable(rpc_) iff rpc_ in set and (rpc_ = empty-set or forsome([rpen_ in fun(nn, rpc_)], forall([rpy_ in rpc_], forsome([rpn_ in nn], rpy_ = rpen_(rpn_))))))

is-countable-pseudometric-family

forall([fam, ground], is-countable-pseudometric-family(fam, ground) iff forall([n_ in nn], is-pseudometric-space(fam(n_)) and pts(fam(n_)) == ground))

is-countably-separated

forall([ys, cb], is-countably-separated(ys, cb) iff is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) and forsome([csf_ in fun(nn, cb)], forall([csx_ in ys, csy_ in ys], not(csx_ = csy_) implies forsome([csk_ in nn], csx_ in csf_(csk_) and not(csy_ in csf_(csk_)) or csy_ in csf_(csk_) and not(csx_ in csf_(csk_))))))

is-cyclic-for

forall([vnv_, vns_, vnx_], is-cyclic-for(vnv_, vns_, vnx_) iff vnx_ in vec(vnv_) and forall([vny_ in vec(vnv_), vne_], pos-rr(vne_) implies forsome([vna_ in vns_], ip-norm(vnv_, (vadd(vnv_))(vny_, (vneg(vnv_))(vna_(vnx_)))) < vne_)))

is-cyclic-vector

is-cyclic-vector-rep

forall([g4a_, g4v_, g4p_, g4e_], is-cyclic-vector-rep(g4a_, g4v_, g4p_, g4e_) iff g4e_ in vec(g4v_) and closure(ip-metric-space(g4v_), rep-orbit(g4a_, g4v_, g4p_, g4e_)) = vec(g4v_))

is-decrypt-trace

forall([sasp_, sas_], is-decrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sak_ in keys(sasp_), sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, (kinv(sasp_))(sak_)], [received, encr(sag_, sak_)], [sent, sag_]]))

is-degree-function

forall([gfs_, gfn_], is-degree-function(gfs_, gfn_) iff is-integral-domain(gfs_) and gfn_ in fun(carr(gfs_), nn) and forall([gfa_ in carr(gfs_), gfb_ in carr(gfs_)], not(gfa_ = zero(gfs_)) implies not(gfb_ = zero(gfs_)) implies gfn_(gfa_) <= gfn_((mul(gfs_))(gfa_, gfb_))) and forall([gfa_ in carr(gfs_), gfb_ in carr(gfs_)], not(gfa_ = zero(gfs_)) implies forsome([gfq_ in carr(gfs_)], gfb_ = (mul(gfs_))(gfa_, gfq_) or gfn_((add(gfs_))(gfb_, (neg(gfs_))((mul(gfs_))(gfa_, gfq_)))) < gfn_(gfa_))))

is-dense

forall([dns_, dna_], is-dense(dns_, dna_) iff is-metric-space(dns_) and dna_ subset pts(dns_) and pts(dns_) subset closure(dns_, dna_))

is-dense-seq

forall([s, dseq], is-dense-seq(s, dseq) iff is-metric-space(s) and dseq in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([m in nn], (dist(s))(x, dseq(m)) < eps)))

is-diagonal

is-diff-at

forall([f, a, l], is-diff-at(f, a, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and l in rr and forsome([phi in fun(rr, rr)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x in rr], f(x) - f(a) = phi(x) * (x - a))))

is-diff-at-v

is-diff-on

forall([k, u, f, a, l], is-diff-on(k, u, f, a, l) iff is-normed-field(k) and is-open(nf-metric-space(k), u) and f in fun(u, carr(k)) and a in u and l in carr(k) and forsome([phi in fun(u, carr(k))], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(k), u), nf-metric-space(k), phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x in u], (add(k))(f(x), (neg(k))(f(a))) = (mul(k))(phi(x), (add(k))(x, (neg(k))(a))))))

is-discrete-ms

forall([dms_], is-discrete-ms(dms_) iff forall([dmx_ in pts(dms_)], forsome([dmr_], pos-rr(dmr_) and forall([dmy_ in ball(dms_, dmx_, dmr_)], dmy_ = dmx_))))

is-distributive

forall([addop, mulop, crr], is-distributive(addop, mulop, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], mulop(u, addop(v, w)) = addop(mulop(u, v), mulop(u, w)) and mulop(addop(u, v), w) = addop(mulop(u, w), mulop(v, w))))

is-doubling

forall([mhf_], is-doubling(mhf_) iff mhf_ in fun(nnreal, nnreal) and mhf_(0) = 0 and forall([mhr_ in nnreal, mhq_ in nnreal], mhr_ <= mhq_ implies mhf_(mhr_) <= mhf_(mhq_)) and forsome([mhp_], pos-rr(mhp_) and forall([mhr_ in rr], 0 < mhr_ implies mhf_(2 * mhr_) <= mhp_ * mhf_(mhr_))))

is-dualizing-character

is-dynkin-system

forall([omega, dd], is-dynkin-system(omega, dd) iff omega in set and dd subset power(omega) and omega in dd and forall([dya_ in dd, dyb_ in dd], dya_ subset dyb_ implies complement-in(dyb_, dya_) in dd) and forall([dyf_ in fun(nn, dd)], forall([dyn_ in nn], dyf_(dyn_) subset dyf_(succ(dyn_))) implies big-union(dyk_, nn, dyf_(dyk_)) in dd))

is-e-bicharacter

forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_], is-e-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) iff c6vw_ in fun(cartesian(vec(c6vm_), vec(c6vm_)), unit-circle) and forall([c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vz_ in vec(c6vm_)], c6vw_((vadd(c6vm_))(c6vx_, c6vy_), c6vz_) = c6vw_(c6vx_, c6vz_) * c6vw_(c6vy_, c6vz_) and c6vw_(c6vz_, (vadd(c6vm_))(c6vx_, c6vy_)) = c6vw_(c6vz_, c6vx_) * c6vw_(c6vz_, c6vy_)) and forall([c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_)], is-add-character(c6vk_, vnb-lambda(c6va_, carr(c6vk_), c6vw_((act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_), c6vy_))) and is-add-character(c6vk_, vnb-lambda(c6va_, carr(c6vk_), c6vw_(c6vy_, (act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_))))))

is-e-bilinear-bicharacter

forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_], is-e-bilinear-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) iff is-e-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) and forall([c6va_ in carr(c6vk_), c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_)], c6vw_((act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_), c6vy_) = c6vw_(c6vx_, (act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vy_))))

is-e-unipolar

forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vn_, c6vw_], is-e-unipolar(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vn_, c6vw_) iff is-norm-on(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vn_) and is-e-bilinear-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) and e-polar(c6vm_, c6vw_, norm-ball(c6vm_, c6vn_, 1)) = norm-ball(c6vm_, c6vn_, 1))

is-eigenvalue

forall([kqv_, kqt_, kqc_], is-eigenvalue(kqv_, kqt_, kqc_) iff kqc_ in cc and forsome([kqx_ in eigenspace(kqv_, kqt_, kqc_)], not(kqx_ = vzero(kqv_))))

is-element-order

forall([g, x, d], is-element-order(g, x, d) iff d in nn and 1 <= d and gpow(g, x, d) = iden(g) and forall([eod_ in nn], 1 <= eod_ implies gpow(g, x, eod_) = iden(g) implies d <= eod_))

is-elementary

forall([r, n, e], is-elementary(r, n, e) iff forsome([elk_, ell_], elk_ in interval(1, n) and ell_ in interval(1, n) and not(elk_ = ell_) and e = elem-f(r, n, elk_, ell_)) or forsome([elr_, elk_, ell_], elr_ in carr(r) and elk_ in interval(1, n) and ell_ in interval(1, n) and not(elk_ = ell_) and e = elem-g(r, n, elr_, elk_, ell_)) or forsome([elr_, elk_], elr_ in carr(r) and forsome([els_ in carr(r)], (mul(r))(elr_, els_) = one(r) and (mul(r))(els_, elr_) = one(r)) and elk_ in interval(1, n) and e = elem-h(r, n, elr_, elk_)))

is-encrypt-trace

forall([sasp_, sas_], is-encrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sak_ in keys(sasp_), sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, sak_], [received, sag_], [sent, encr(sag_, sak_)]]))

is-entry-point

forall([ssp_, ssn_, ssi_], is-entry-point(ssp_, ssn_, ssi_) iff ssn_ in nodes(ssp_) and is-sent(ssp_, ssn_) and node-content(ssp_, ssn_) in ssi_ and forall([ssm_], same-strand-before(ssp_, ssm_, ssn_) implies not(node-content(ssp_, ssm_) in ssi_)))

is-eps-cauchy-seq

forall([s, eps, y], is-eps-cauchy-seq(s, eps, y) iff is-metric-space(s) and y in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], (dist(s))(y(m), y(n_)) <= eps))

is-equicontinuous-set

forall([eqss_, eqst_, eqse_], is-equicontinuous-set(eqss_, eqst_, eqse_) iff is-metric-space(eqss_) and is-metric-space(eqst_) and eqse_ subset fun(pts(eqss_), pts(eqst_)) and forall([eqsx_ in pts(eqss_), eqsp_], pos-rr(eqsp_) implies forsome([eqsd_], pos-rr(eqsd_) and forall([eqsf_ in eqse_, eqsy_ in pts(eqss_)], (dist(eqss_))(eqsx_, eqsy_) < eqsd_ implies (dist(eqst_))(eqsf_(eqsx_), eqsf_(eqsy_)) < eqsp_))))

is-equivalence

forall([rho, crr], is-equivalence(rho, crr) iff rho in power(cartesian(crr, crr)) and forall([u in crr], [u, u] in rho) and forall([u in crr, v in crr], [u, v] in rho implies [v, u] in rho) and forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], [u, v] in rho and [v, w] in rho implies [u, w] in rho))

is-ess-self-adjoint-graph

is-euclidean-domain

is-eventually-in

is-extremal-subset

is-extreme-point

forall([epm_, epk_, epx_], is-extreme-point(epm_, epk_, epx_) iff epx_ in epk_ and forall([epu_ in epk_, epv_ in epk_, ept_ in rr], 0 < ept_ implies ept_ < 1 implies epx_ = (vadd(epm_))((act(epm_))(1 - ept_, epu_), (act(epm_))(ept_, epv_)) implies epu_ = epx_ and epv_ = epx_))

is-faithful-bicharacter

is-fg-cc-module-over

forall([aa, vv], is-fg-cc-module-over(aa, vv) iff is-cc-module-over(aa, vv) and forsome([amn_ in nn, amg_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), vv)], forall([amv_ in vv], forsome([amb_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), aa)], amv_ = cc-lincomb(amn_, amb_, amg_)))))

is-fin-ext

forall([x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_], is-fin-ext(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_) iff is-normed-field(x4k_) and is-field-ring(x4f_) and is-module(x4md_) and scal(x4md_) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(x4k_) and vec(x4md_) = carr(x4f_) and vadd(x4md_) = add(x4f_) and vzero(x4md_) = zero(x4f_) and vneg(x4md_) = neg(x4f_) and forall([x4r_ in carr(x4k_), x4x_ in carr(x4f_), x4y_ in carr(x4f_)], (mul(x4f_))(x4x_, (act(x4md_))(x4r_, x4y_)) = (act(x4md_))(x4r_, (mul(x4f_))(x4x_, x4y_))) and x4n_ in nn and 1 <= x4n_ and x4u_ in mat(x4n_, 1, carr(x4f_)) and generates(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_) and rel-free(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_))

is-finite-cover

is-finite-measure

is-finite-rank-op

forall([kqv_, kqw_, kqt_], is-finite-rank-op(kqv_, kqw_, kqt_) iff kqt_ in bounded-ops(kqv_, kqw_) and forsome([kqi_ in set], card(kqi_) in nn and forsome([kqa_ in fun(kqi_, vec(kqv_)), kqb_ in fun(kqi_, vec(kqw_))], forall([kqx_ in vec(kqv_)], kqt_(kqx_) = finsum(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(ip-normed-ag(kqw_)), vnb-lambda(kqk_, kqi_, (act(kqw_))((ip(kqv_))(kqx_, kqa_(kqk_)), kqb_(kqk_))), kqi_)))))

is-flat-regular

is-flush-trace

is-fr-bounded

is-fr-equicont

is-fractions-of

forall([cwk_, cwa_], is-fractions-of(cwk_, cwa_) iff forall([cwx_ in carr(cwk_)], forsome([cwu_ in cwa_, cwv_ in cwa_], not(cwv_ = zero(cwk_)) and (mul(cwk_))(cwx_, cwv_) = cwu_)))

is-frechet-structure

is-fubini-set

forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs], is-fubini-set(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs) iff is-measurable-fn(xs, ca, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, cs)) and is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs)) and integral(xs, ca, mu, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, cs)) = integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs)))

is-functional-graph

forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-functional-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff forall([ubx_ in vec(ubv_), uby_ in vec(ubv_), ubz_ in vec(ubv_)], [ubx_, uby_] in ubg_ implies [ubx_, ubz_] in ubg_ implies uby_ = ubz_))

is-gauge-countable

forall([s], is-gauge-countable(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forsome([fam], is-countable-pseudometric-family(fam, pts(s)) and pseudo-gauge-top(fam, pts(s)) == s))

is-gcd-set

forall([ggs_, ggt_, ggd_], is-gcd-set(ggs_, ggt_, ggd_) iff ggd_ in carr(ggs_) and forall([ggx_ in ggt_], divides(ggs_, ggd_, ggx_)) and forall([gge_ in carr(ggs_)], forall([ggx_ in ggt_], divides(ggs_, gge_, ggx_)) implies divides(ggs_, gge_, ggd_)))

is-generator

forall([g, x], is-generator(g, x) iff x in carr(g) and forall([geny_ in carr(g)], forsome([genk_ in zz], geny_ = group-zpow(g, x, genk_))))

is-group-metric

forall([mgm_, mgg_], is-group-metric(mgm_, mgg_) iff is-metric-space(mgm_) and is-group(mgg_) and pts(mgm_) = carr(mgg_) and forall([mgu_ in carr(mgg_), mgv_ in carr(mgg_), mge_], pos-rr(mge_) implies forsome([mgd_], pos-rr(mgd_) and forall([mgp_ in carr(mgg_), mgq_ in carr(mgg_)], (dist(mgm_))(mgu_, mgp_) <= mgd_ implies (dist(mgm_))(mgv_, mgq_) <= mgd_ implies (dist(mgm_))((opr(mgg_))(mgu_, mgv_), (opr(mgg_))(mgp_, mgq_)) <= mge_))) and is-continuous(mgm_, mgm_, inv(mgg_)))

is-group-norm

forall([nm, op, invop, unit, crr], is-group-norm(nm, op, invop, unit, crr) iff nm in fun(crr, rr) and forall([u in crr], 0 <= nm(u) and (nm(u) = 0 iff u = unit) and nm(invop(u)) = nm(u) and forall([v in crr], nm(op(u, v)) <= nm(u) + nm(v))))

is-group-segment

forall([gss_, gsg_, gsa_, gsp_], is-group-segment(gss_, gsg_, gsa_, gsp_) iff pos-rr(gsa_) and gsp_ in fun(ccint(0, gsa_), carr(gsg_)) and forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, gsa_), gsu_ in ccint(0, gsa_)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= gsa_ implies gsp_(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(gsg_))(gsp_(gsr_), gsp_(gsu_))) and forall([gst_ in ccint(0, gsa_), gsw_ in opens(gss_)], gsp_(gst_) in gsw_ implies forsome([gsd_], pos-rr(gsd_) and forall([gsv_ in ccint(0, gsa_)], abs(gsv_ - gst_) < gsd_ implies gsp_(gsv_) in gsw_))))

forall([orsp_, orss_, orsa_, orsb_, orsn_, orso_, orsm_, orsk_], is-or-serv(orsp_, orss_, orsa_, orsb_, orsn_, orso_, orsm_, orsk_) iff orsa_ in sk-names(orsp_) and orsb_ in sk-names(orsp_) and is-or-text(orsp_, orsn_) and is-or-text(orsp_, orso_) and is-or-text(orsp_, orsm_) and orsk_ in keys(ispace(sk-inf(orsp_))) and not(orsk_ in adv-tokens(sk-inf(orsp_))) and forall([orsx_ in sk-names(orsp_)], not(orsk_ = (ltkey(orsp_))(orsx_))) and (kinv(ispace(sk-inf(orsp_))))(orsk_) = orsk_ and orss_ = [[received, lst([orsm_, orsa_, orsb_, encr(lst([orsn_, orsm_, orsa_, orsb_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsa_)), encr(lst([orso_, orsm_, orsa_, orsb_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsb_))])], [sent, lst([orsm_, encr(lst([orsn_, orsk_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsa_)), encr(lst([orso_, orsk_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsb_))])]])

is-or-space

forall([orqp_], is-or-space(orqp_) iff is-sk-space(orqp_) and forall([orqi_ in ids(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_)))], orqi_ in adv-ids(sk-inf(orqp_)) or forsome([orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_], is-or-init(orqp_, (strand-map(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_))))(orqi_), orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_)) or forsome([orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_, orqh_, orqg_], is-or-resp(orqp_, (strand-map(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_))))(orqi_), orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_, orqh_, orqg_)) or forsome([orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqo_, orqm_, orqk_], is-or-serv(orqp_, (strand-map(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_))))(orqi_), orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqo_, orqm_, orqk_))))

is-or-text

forall([ortp_, ortx_], is-or-text(ortp_, ortx_) iff ortx_ in tokens(ispace(sk-inf(ortp_))) and not(ortx_ in sk-names(ortp_)) and not(ortx_ in keys(ispace(sk-inf(ortp_)))))

is-order-iso

forall([oisf_, oisa_, oisb_], is-order-iso(oisf_, oisa_, oisb_) iff oisf_ in bijection(oisa_, oisb_) and forall([oisx_ in oisa_, oisy_ in oisa_], oisx_ < oisy_ implies oisf_(oisx_) < oisf_(oisy_)))

is-orthogonal-projection

forall([v, ks, pk], is-orthogonal-projection(v, ks, pk) iff pk in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) and forall([opz_ in vec(v)], pk(opz_) in ks and (vadd(v))(opz_, (vneg(v))(pk(opz_))) in perp(v, ks)))

is-orthonormal-basis

forall([v, ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) iff is-orthonormal-family(v, ix, e) and forall([onx_ in vec(v)], forall([oni_ in ix], (ip(v))(onx_, e(oni_)) = 0) implies onx_ = vzero(v)))

is-orthonormal-family

forall([v, ix, e], is-orthonormal-family(v, ix, e) iff e in fun(ix, vec(v)) and forall([oni_ in ix], (ip(v))(e(oni_), e(oni_)) = 1) and forall([oni_ in ix, onj_ in ix], not(oni_ = onj_) implies (ip(v))(e(oni_), e(onj_)) = 0))

is-orthonormal-set

forall([v, os], is-orthonormal-set(v, os) iff os subset vec(v) and forall([osa_ in os], (ip(v))(osa_, osa_) = 1) and forall([osa_ in os, osb_ in os], not(osa_ = osb_) implies (ip(v))(osa_, osb_) = 0))

is-outer-measure

forall([omega, mu], is-outer-measure(omega, mu) iff omega in set and mu in fun(power(omega), rr-pos-star) and mu(empty-set) = 0 and forall([a_, b_], a_ in power(omega) implies b_ in power(omega) implies a_ subset b_ implies mu(a_) <= mu(b_)) and forall([f_ in fun(nn, power(omega))], mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) <= esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))))))

is-partial-isometry

forall([bov_, bot_], is-partial-isometry(bov_, bot_) iff bot_ in bounded-ops(bov_, bov_) and forsome([bok_], is-submodule(bov_, bok_) and is-closed(ip-metric-space(bov_), bok_) and is-isometric-on(bov_, bov_, bot_, bok_) and forall([box_ in perp(bov_, bok_)], bot_(box_) = vzero(bov_))))

is-partial-order

forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) iff grd in set and porel in set and forall([x in grd], [x, x] in porel) and forall([x in grd, y in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, x] in porel implies x = y) and forall([x in grd, y in grd, z in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, z] in porel implies [x, z] in porel))

is-partition

forall([p, n, a, b], is-partition(p, n, a, b) iff n in nn and 1 <= n and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and p in fun(nn, rr) and p(0) = a and p(n) = b and forall([i_, j_], i_ in interval(0, n) and j_ in interval(0, n) and i_ < j_ implies p(i_) < p(j_)))

is-path

forall([pgam, a, b], is-path(pgam, a, b) iff a in rr and b in rr and a < b and pgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) and forall([pax_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), cc-ms, pgam, pax_)))

is-path-connected

forall([pcs_, pca_], is-path-connected(pcs_, pca_) iff is-metric-space(pcs_) and pca_ subset pts(pcs_) and forall([pcx_ in pca_, pcy_ in pca_], forsome([pcg_ in fun(ccint(0, 1), pca_)], is-continuous(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(0, 1)), pcs_, pcg_) and pcg_(0) = pcx_ and pcg_(1) = pcy_)))

is-pi-system

forall([pp], is-pi-system(pp) iff forall([pya_ in pp, pyb_ in pp], intersection(pya_, pyb_) in pp))

is-piecewise-continuous

forall([f, a, b], is-piecewise-continuous(f, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forsome([n_, p_], is-partition(p_, n_, a, b) and forall([i_], i_ in interval(0, n_) and i_ < n_ implies forall([t_], t_ in rr and p_(i_) < t_ and t_ < p_(succ(i_)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, t_)))))

is-point-separating

forall([rst_, rsa_], is-point-separating(rst_, rsa_) iff forall([rsp_ in pts(rst_), rsq_ in pts(rst_)], not(rsp_ = rsq_) implies forsome([rsf_ in rsa_], not(rsf_(rsp_) = rsf_(rsq_)))))

is-pole

forall([mrf_, mra_, mrn_], is-pole(mrf_, mra_, mrn_) iff mra_ in cc and mrn_ in nn and 1 <= mrn_ and forsome([mrr_ in rr], 0 < mrr_ and forsome([mrg_], holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), mrg_) and not(mrg_(mra_) = 0) and forall([mrz_ in difference(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), singleton(mra_))], mrf_(mrz_) = recip(mrz_ - mra_) ^ mrn_ * mrg_(mrz_)))))

is-polish

forall([s], is-polish(s) iff is-complete(s) and is-separable(s))

is-poly-deg

forall([kk, a, f, n], is-poly-deg(kk, a, f, n) iff a subset kk and f in fun(a, kk) and forsome([pfc_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([pfk_ in nn], succ(n) <= pfk_ implies pfc_(pfk_) = 0) and not(pfc_(n) = 0) and forall([pfz_ in a], f(pfz_) = cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, pfc_(pfj_) * pfz_ ^ pfj_), succ(n)))))

is-poly-fn-on

forall([kk, a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) iff a subset kk and f in fun(a, kk) and forsome([pfn_ in nn, pfc_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([pfk_ in nn], pfn_ <= pfk_ implies pfc_(pfk_) = 0) and forall([pfz_ in a], f(pfz_) = cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, pfc_(pfj_) * pfz_ ^ pfj_), pfn_))))

is-positive-form

forall([ubv_, ubd_, ubf_], is-positive-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) iff is-quadratic-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) and forall([ubx_ in ubd_], ubf_(ubx_, ubx_) in rr and 0 <= ubf_(ubx_, ubx_)))

is-positive-functional

forall([s, lam], is-positive-functional(s, lam) iff lam in fun(cont-fns(s), rr) and forall([pff_ in cont-fns(s), pfg_ in cont-fns(s)], lam(vnb-lambda(sx_, pts(s), pff_(sx_) + pfg_(sx_))) = lam(pff_) + lam(pfg_)) and forall([pfc_ in rr, pff_ in cont-fns(s)], lam(vnb-lambda(sx_, pts(s), pfc_ * pff_(sx_))) = pfc_ * lam(pff_)) and forall([pff_ in cont-fns(s)], forall([pfx_ in pts(s)], 0 <= pff_(pfx_)) implies 0 <= lam(pff_)))

is-positive-lf

forall([g4a_, g4f_], is-positive-lf(g4a_, g4f_) iff is-cc-linear-on(g4a_, g4f_) and forall([g4x_ in vec(g4a_)], g4f_((vmul(g4a_))((vstar(g4a_))(g4x_), g4x_)) in rr and 0 <= g4f_((vmul(g4a_))((vstar(g4a_))(g4x_), g4x_))))

is-positive-op

forall([kqv_, kqt_], is-positive-op(kqv_, kqt_) iff is-self-adjoint-op(kqv_, kqt_) and forall([kqx_ in vec(kqv_)], (ip(kqv_))(kqt_(kqx_), kqx_) in rr and 0 <= (ip(kqv_))(kqt_(kqx_), kqx_)))

is-power-bounded

forall([k, n, tm], is-power-bounded(k, n, tm) iff forsome([cbvc_], is-power-bounded-by(k, n, tm, cbvc_)))

is-power-bounded-by

forall([k, n, tm, c], is-power-bounded-by(k, n, tm, c) iff tm in mat(n, n, carr(k)) and c in rr and 0 <= c and forall([cbvk_ in nn], is-mat-bound(k, n, n, mat-power(k, n, tm, cbvk_), c)))

is-prec-closed

forall([spc_, snd_, ssd_, srl_], is-prec-closed(spc_, snd_, ssd_, srl_) iff forall([ssx_, ssy_], [ssx_, ssy_] in ssd_ implies [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_) and forall([ssx_ in snd_, ssy_ in snd_], same-strand-before(spc_, ssx_, ssy_) implies [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_) and forall([ssx_, ssy_, ssz_], [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_ implies [ssy_, ssz_] in srl_ implies [ssx_, ssz_] in srl_))

is-premeasure

forall([omega, cls, pm], is-premeasure(omega, cls, pm) iff omega in set and cls subset power(omega) and empty-set in cls and pm in fun(cls, rr-pos-star) and pm(empty-set) = 0)

is-prime-element

forall([gps_, gpp_], is-prime-element(gps_, gpp_) iff gpp_ in carr(gps_) and not(gpp_ = zero(gps_)) and not(is-unit(gps_, gpp_)) and forall([gpa_ in carr(gps_), gpb_ in carr(gps_)], gpp_ = (mul(gps_))(gpa_, gpb_) implies is-unit(gps_, gpa_) or is-unit(gps_, gpb_)))

is-prime-nat

forall([gpn_], is-prime-nat(gpn_) iff gpn_ in nn and is-prime-element(zz-ring, gpn_))

is-prime-seq

forall([gqs_, gqp_, gqn_], is-prime-seq(gqs_, gqp_, gqn_) iff forall([gqi_ in interval(1, gqn_)], is-prime-element(gqs_, gqp_(gqi_))))

is-primitive

forall([rpg_, rpf_, rpa_, rpb_], is-primitive(rpg_, rpf_, rpa_, rpb_) iff rpa_ in rr and rpb_ in rr and rpa_ < rpb_ and rpg_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and rpf_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and is-continuous-on(rpg_, ccint(rpa_, rpb_)) and forsome([rps_], is-countable(rps_) and rps_ subset ccint(rpa_, rpb_) and forall([rpt_ in ooint(rpa_, rpb_)], not(rpt_ in rps_) implies has-deriv-at(rpg_, rpt_, rpf_(rpt_)))))

is-principal-sequence

forall([md, n, sm, es, dm], is-principal-sequence(md, n, sm, es, dm) iff es in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) and generates(md, n, es) and rel-free(md, n, es) and dm in mat(n, n, zz) and is-diagonal(zz-ring, n, n, dm) and forall([psi_ in interval(1, n)], 0 <= entry(dm, psi_, psi_)) and forall([psi_, psj_], psi_ in interval(1, n) implies psj_ in interval(1, n) implies psi_ <= psj_ implies zz-divides(entry(dm, psi_, psi_), entry(dm, psj_, psj_))) and spans(md, n, matact(md, dm, es), sm))

is-projection-el

forall([baa_, bax_], is-projection-el(baa_, bax_) iff bax_ in vec(baa_) and (vstar(baa_))(bax_) = bax_ and (vmul(baa_))(bax_, bax_) = bax_)

is-projection-op

forall([bov_, bot_], is-projection-op(bov_, bot_) iff bot_ in bounded-ops(bov_, bov_) and op-adjoint(bov_, bov_, bot_) = bot_ and bop-comp(bov_, bot_, bot_) = bot_)

is-psd-form

forall([ipfm_, ipff_], is-psd-form(ipfm_, ipff_) iff is-hermitian-form(ipfm_, ipff_) and forall([ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_)], ipff_(ipfx_, ipfx_) in rr) and forall([ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_)], 0 <= ipff_(ipfx_, ipfx_)))

is-pseudometric

forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) iff forall([u in crr], dst(u, u) = 0 and forall([v in crr], 0 <= dst(u, v) and dst(u, v) = dst(v, u) and forall([w in crr], dst(u, w) <= dst(u, v) + dst(v, w)))))

is-pt-open

forall([t, u], is-pt-open(t, u) iff u subset cartesian(pts(t), rr) and forall([ptw_ in u], forsome([ptv_ in opens(t)], nth(1, ptw_) in ptv_ and forsome([pte_], pos-rr(pte_) and pt-box(t, ptv_, nth(2, ptw_), pte_) subset u))))

is-ptwise-cauchy

forall([s, fam], is-ptwise-cauchy(s, fam) iff is-metric-space(s) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([k], k in nn and cap <= k implies forall([l], l in nn and cap <= l implies abs((fam(k))(x) - (fam(l))(x)) < eps)))))

is-pure-state

forall([g4a_, g4f_], is-pure-state(g4a_, g4f_) iff g4f_ in states(g4a_) and forall([g4g_], is-positive-lf(g4a_, g4g_) implies functional-le(g4a_, g4g_, g4f_) implies forsome([g4l_ in rr], 0 <= g4l_ and g4l_ <= 1 and forall([g4x_ in vec(g4a_)], g4g_(g4x_) = g4l_ * g4f_(g4x_)))))

is-pw-antiderivable

forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-antiderivable(pphi_, a, b) iff forsome([paw_], is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b)))

is-pw-continuous-on

forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) iff a in rr and b in rr and a < b and pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) and forsome([pas_ in set], card(pas_) in nn and pas_ subset ccint(a, b) and forall([pat_ in ooint(a, b)], not(pat_ in pas_) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), rr-ms, pphi_, pat_))))

is-qp-digits

forall([qsp_, qta_, qtn_], is-qp-digits(qsp_, qta_, qtn_) iff qta_ in fun(zz, zz) and forall([qtk_ in zz], 0 <= qta_(qtk_) and qta_(qtk_) < qsp_ and (qtk_ < qtn_ implies qta_(qtk_) = 0)))

is-qp-expansion

forall([qsp_, qta_, qtn_, qtx_], is-qp-expansion(qsp_, qta_, qtn_, qtx_) iff is-qp-digits(qsp_, qta_, qtn_) and converges-to(qp(qsp_), vnb-lambda(qtm_, nn, qp-psum(qsp_, qta_, qtn_, qtm_)), qtx_))

is-quadratic-form

forall([ubv_, ubd_, ubf_], is-quadratic-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) iff is-submodule(ubv_, ubd_) and is-dense(ip-metric-space(ubv_), ubd_) and ubf_ in fun(cartesian(ubd_, ubd_), cc) and forall([ubx_ in ubd_, uby_ in ubd_, ubz_ in ubd_], ubf_((vadd(ubv_))(ubx_, uby_), ubz_) = ubf_(ubx_, ubz_) + ubf_(uby_, ubz_)) and forall([ubk_ in cc, ubx_ in ubd_, uby_ in ubd_], ubf_((act(ubv_))(ubk_, ubx_), uby_) = ubk_ * ubf_(ubx_, uby_)) and forall([ubx_ in ubd_, uby_ in ubd_], ubf_(uby_, ubx_) = conjugate(ubf_(ubx_, uby_))))

is-r-net

forall([s, f, a, r], is-r-net(s, f, a, r) iff f subset a and forall([p in a], forsome([c in f], (dist(s))(c, p) <= r and not((dist(s))(c, p) = r))))

is-rcont-subalgebra

forall([rst_, rsa_], is-rcont-subalgebra(rst_, rsa_) iff rsa_ subset rcont(rst_) and forall([rsc_ in rr], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), rsc_) in rsa_) and forall([rsf_ in rsa_, rsg_ in rsa_], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), rsf_(rsz_) + rsg_(rsz_)) in rsa_) and forall([rsf_ in rsa_, rsg_ in rsa_], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), rsf_(rsz_) * rsg_(rsz_)) in rsa_))

is-real-hilbert-space

forall([v], is-real-hilbert-space(v) iff is-pre-hilbert-space(v) and is-complete(sip-metric-space(v)))

is-real-linear-op

forall([v, jo], is-real-linear-op(v, jo) iff jo in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) and forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], jo((vadd(v))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(v))(jo(x_), jo(y_))) and forall([a_ in rr, x_ in vec(v)], jo((act(v))(a_, x_)) = (act(v))(a_, jo(x_))))

is-real-measurable-fn

forall([omega, ca, f], is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) iff f in fun(omega, rr) and is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, pos-part(omega, f)) and is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, neg-part(omega, f)))

is-real-orthogonal-projection

forall([v, ks, pk], is-real-orthogonal-projection(v, ks, pk) iff pk in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) and forall([sop_ in vec(v)], pk(sop_) in ks and (vadd(v))(sop_, (vneg(v))(pk(sop_))) in sip-perp(v, ks)))

is-received

forall([ssp_, ssn_], is-received(ssp_, ssn_) iff node-dir(ssp_, ssn_) = received)

is-regular-measure

forall([s, mu], is-regular-measure(s, mu) iff is-measure(pts(s), borel-sets(s), mu) and mu(pts(s)) in rr and forall([rge_ in borel-sets(s)], mu(rge_) = esup({rgv_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([rgk_ in power(pts(s))], rgk_ subset rge_ and is-compact(subspace-ms(s, rgk_)) and rgv_ = mu(rgk_))})))

is-regular-node

forall([sai_, san_], is-regular-node(sai_, san_) iff not(nth(2, san_) in adv-ids(sai_)))

is-regulated

forall([f, a, b], is-regulated(f, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], (x_ < b implies forsome([l_], is-right-limit(f, x_, l_))) and (a < x_ implies forsome([l_], is-left-limit(f, x_, l_)))))

is-regulated-on

forall([rpf_, rpa_, rpb_], is-regulated-on(rpf_, rpa_, rpb_) iff rpa_ in rr and rpb_ in rr and rpa_ < rpb_ and rpf_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and forall([rpx_ in ccint(rpa_, rpb_)], rpx_ < rpb_ implies forsome([rpl_], is-right-limit-within(rpf_, ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rpx_, rpl_))) and forall([rpx_ in ccint(rpa_, rpb_)], rpa_ < rpx_ implies forsome([rpl_], is-left-limit-within(rpf_, ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rpx_, rpl_))))

is-removable-singularity

forall([mrf_, mra_], is-removable-singularity(mrf_, mra_) iff mra_ in cc and forsome([mrr_ in rr], 0 < mrr_ and forsome([mrg_], holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), mrg_) and forall([mrz_ in difference(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), singleton(mra_))], mrf_(mrz_) = mrg_(mrz_)))))

is-representation

forall([g4a_, g4v_, g4p_], is-representation(g4a_, g4v_, g4p_) iff is-hilbert-space(g4v_) and is-star-hom(g4a_, bh-algebra(g4v_), g4p_))

is-resp-strand

forall([nlp_, nls_, nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_], is-resp-strand(nlp_, nls_, nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_) iff nla_ in names(nlp_) and nlb_ in names(nlp_) and nlm_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))) and nln_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))) and not(nln_ in names(nlp_)) and not(nlm_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_)))) and not(nln_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_)))) and nls_ = [[received, encr(lst([nlm_, nla_]), (pubkey(nlp_))(nlb_))], [sent, encr(lst([nlm_, nln_, nlb_]), (pubkey(nlp_))(nla_))], [received, encr(nln_, (pubkey(nlp_))(nlb_))]])

is-right-ideal

forall([baa_, bai_], is-right-ideal(baa_, bai_) iff is-alg-subspace(baa_, bai_) and forall([bay_ in vec(baa_), bax_ in bai_], (vmul(baa_))(bax_, bay_) in bai_))

is-right-limit

forall([f, x, l], is-right-limit(f, x, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and x in rr and l in rr and forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([t_], t_ in rr and x < t_ and t_ <= x + delta_ implies abs(f(t_) - l) <= eps_))))

is-right-limit-within

forall([rpf_, rpw_, rpx_, rpl_], is-right-limit-within(rpf_, rpw_, rpx_, rpl_) iff rpw_ subset rr and rpf_ in fun(rpw_, rr) and rpx_ in rr and rpl_ in rr and forall([rpe_], pos-rr(rpe_) implies forsome([rpdl_], pos-rr(rpdl_) and forall([rpt_ in rpw_], rpx_ < rpt_ implies rpt_ < rpx_ + rpdl_ implies abs(rpf_(rpt_) - rpl_) < rpe_))))

is-ring-iso

forall([rib_, ric_, rif_], is-ring-iso(rib_, ric_, rif_) iff is-hom-ring(rib_, ric_, rif_) and forall([riu_ in carr(rib_), riv_ in carr(rib_)], rif_(riu_) = rif_(riv_) implies riu_ = riv_) and forall([riw_ in carr(ric_)], forsome([riz_ in carr(rib_)], rif_(riz_) = riw_)))

is-road

is-self-adjoint-el

is-self-adjoint-op

is-seminorm-on

is-sieve

rw-sep-body

forall([mrt_, mrs_, mrx_], rw-sep-body(mrt_, mrs_, mrx_) iff forsome([mrg_, mra_, mrb_, mrc_], mrx_ = [1, mrg_, enc-sep(mrc_, mra_), enc-sep(mrc_, mrb_)] and enc-sep(mrc_, mra_) in clt and enc-sep(mrc_, mrb_) in clt and forsome([mrfs_ in set], mrfs_ subset nn and card(mrfs_) in nn and forall([mry_ in nn], not(mry_ in mrfs_) implies [2, mrg_, expr-open(mra_, 0, efvar(mry_)), expr-open(mrb_, 0, efvar(mry_))] in mrs_))))

rw-tbind-body

strict-head

Recursively-defined functoids

Defined by primitive recursion on NN (def-by-nn-recursion): a name-zero base and a name-succ step. The extra parameters range over a class (a ring, a monoid, ...), so each is a functoid, not a function.

cc-partial-prod

laurent-inv-pre

forall([lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_], laurent-inv-pre(lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_, 0) == laurent-mono(lrk_, lra_, -lro_))

forall([lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_, lrm_ in nn], laurent-inv-pre(lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_, succ(lrm_)) == laurent-add(lrk_, laurent-inv-pre(lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_, lrm_), laurent-mono(lrk_, (neg(lrk_))((mul(lrk_))(lra_, (laurent-mul(lrk_, lrf_, laurent-inv-pre(lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_, lrm_)))(lrm_ + 1))), (lrm_ + 1) + -lro_)))

received = 1

recip-gamma

recip-gamma == vnb-lambda(egz_, cc, (egz_ * cc-exp(euler-gamma * egz_)) * (prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, -succ(c6gk_)))(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, -succ(c6gk_)))(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, 1))(c6k_)))) - 1))))(egz_))

rm-two

rm-two == pair(0, 1)

rm-two-ms

rm-two-ms == subspace-ms(rr-ms, rm-two)

rr-bounded-ms

rr-bounded-ms == bdd-metric(rr-ms)

rr-ext-down

rr-ext-down == union(rr, singleton(neg-inf))

rr-ext-up

rr-ext-up == union(rr, singleton(pos-inf))

rr-field

rr-field = [rr, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_), 0, 1, difference(rr, singleton(0)), vnb-lambda(x_, difference(rr, singleton(0)), recip(x_))]

rr-ms

rr-ms = [rr, vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(rr, rr), abs(x - y))]

rr-normed-field

rr-normed-field = [rr, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_), 0, 1, vnb-lambda(x_, rr, abs(x_))]

rr-nvs

rr-nvs = [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field), rr, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_), 0, vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_), vnb-lambda([r_, x_], cartesian(rr, rr), r_ * x_), vnb-lambda(x_, rr, abs(x_))]

rr-pos-star-add-monoid

rr-pos-star-add-monoid = [rr-pos-star, eplus, 0]

rw-univ

rw-univ == cartesian(nn, ctx-set, expr-set, expr-set)

sent

sent = 0

seq-set

seq-set == cartesian(ctx-set, clf)

triv-group

triv-group = [pair(0, 0), vnb-lambda([tgp_, tgq_], cartesian(pair(0, 0), pair(0, 0)), 0), 0, vnb-lambda(tgp_, pair(0, 0), 0)]

unit-circle

unit-circle == {ucz_ in cc: magnitude(ucz_) = 1}

unit-sphere-cr

unit-sphere-cr == {hsp_ in cartesian(cc, rr): magnitude(nth(1, hsp_)) * magnitude(nth(1, hsp_)) + nth(2, hsp_) * nth(2, hsp_) = 1}

upper-half-plane

upper-half-plane == {hpz_ in cc: 0 < imag-part(hpz_)}

zero-ring

zero-ring = [{0}, vnb-lambda([p, q], cartesian({0}, {0}), 0), vnb-lambda([p, q], cartesian({0}, {0}), 0), vnb-lambda(p, {0}, 0), 0, 0]

zz-add-monoid

zz-add-monoid = [zz, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_), 0]

zz-ring

zz-ring = [zz, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, zz, -x_), 0, 1]

Unfold-only constructors (functoids)

def-functoid heads, written name(params) := body: the macete rewrites name(args) to that body, and there is no theorem — which is why these are absent from the def-* registry above. FUNCTORS.md lists the same set split into set/structure-valued and value functoids.

TRAP worth knowing before citing one: mac unfolds a functoid in a GOAL, but mac-h cannot unfold it in an assumption — def-functoid installs no theorem for it to look up, so mac-h warns unknown theorem/macete and the driver continues with the hypothesis untouched. A constructor whose members get read out of the CONTEXT therefore also carries a membership iff, stamped definitional, in the section below — that iff is a consequence of the definition here, not the definition.

abs-fn

abs-fn(omega, f) := vnb-lambda(afx_, omega, abs(f(afx_)))

abs-op

abs-op(kqv_, kqt_) := op-sqrt(kqv_, bop-comp(kqv_, op-adjoint(kqv_, kqv_, kqt_), kqt_))

adj

adj(r, n, a) := matof(succ(n), succ(n), vnb-lambda([adu_, adv_], cartesian(interval(1, succ(n)), interval(1, succ(n))), (mul(r))(mpow(ring-multiplicative-monoid(r), (neg(r))(one(r)), adu_ + adv_), det(r, n, minor(a, adv_, adu_, n)))))

adjoin-char-value

adjoin-char-value(a6vg_, a6vh_, a6vc_, a6vb_, a6vt_, a6vy_) := iota(a6vw_, a6vw_ in cc and forsome([a6vq_ in a6vh_, a6vl_ in zz], a6vy_ = (opr(a6vg_))(a6vq_, zz-act(a6vg_, a6vl_, a6vb_)) and a6vw_ = a6vc_(a6vq_) * cc-exp(a6vl_ * a6vt_)))

ae-rel

ae-rel(omega, ca, mu, sf) := {aep_ in cartesian(sf, sf): forsome([aen_ in set], is-null-set(omega, ca, mu, aen_) and forall([aex_ in omega], not(aex_ in aen_) implies (nth(1, aep_))(aex_) = (nth(2, aep_))(aex_)))}

ae-setoid

ae-setoid(omega, ca, mu, sf) := [sf, ae-rel(omega, ca, mu, sf)]

aff-der

aff-der(hmp_, hmq_, hmc_, hmd_) := vnb-lambda(hmz_, ccint(hmc_, hmd_), recip(hmd_ - hmc_) * (hmq_ - hmp_))

aff-seg

aff-seg(hmp_, hmq_, hmc_, hmd_) := vnb-lambda(hmz_, ccint(hmc_, hmd_), hmp_ + ((hmz_ - hmc_) * recip(hmd_ - hmc_)) * (hmq_ - hmp_))

ag-zz-module

ag-zz-module(qag_) := [zz-ring, carr(qag_), opr(qag_), iden(qag_), inv(qag_), vnb-lambda([azk_, aza_], cartesian(zz, carr(qag_)), zz-act(qag_, azk_, aza_))]

agree-length

agree-length(alx_, aly_) := iota(alk_, alk_ in nn and not(alx_(alk_) = aly_(alk_)) and forall([alj_ in nn], alj_ < alk_ implies alx_(alj_) = aly_(alj_)))

algebraic-numbers-over

algebraic-numbers-over(kk) := {anth_ in cc: is-algebraic-over-field(kk, anth_)}

all-spine

all-spine(mnbb_) := {mnbz_ in cartesian(expr-set, nn): forall([mnbv_ in power(cartesian(expr-set, nn))], [mnbb_, 0] in mnbv_ implies all-spine-closed(mnbv_) implies mnbz_ in mnbv_)}

amp-step

amp-step(amv_, amw_, amf_) := vnb-lambda(amt_, bounded-ops(amv_, amv_), hsum-diag(amw_, amv_, amf_(amt_), amt_))

angle

angle(ang1_, ang2_) := pi + imag-part(choice({angz_ in cc: -pi <= imag-part(angz_) and imag-part(angz_) < pi and cc-exp(angz_) = -(ang1_ * conjugate(ang2_))}))

annulus

annulus(anla_, anlr_, anls_) := {anlz_ in cc: anlr_ < magnitude(anlz_ - anla_) and magnitude(anlz_ - anla_) < anls_}

antiderivable-fns

antiderivable-fns(ada_, adb_) := {adp_ in fun(rr, rr): is-antiderivable(adp_, ada_, adb_)}

atoms

atoms(ca) := {mat_ in ca: is-atom(ca, mat_)}

ba-metric-space

ba-metric-space(baa_) := nag-metric-space(uba-as-normed-ag(baa_))

baire-code

baire-code(bcm_) := vnb-lambda(bck_, nn, nnfst(snd-iter(bcm_, bck_)))

ball

ball(s, c, r) := {y in pts(s): (dist(s))(c, y) <= r and not((dist(s))(c, y) = r)}

ball-cover

ball-cover(s, r) := image(vnb-lambda(c, pts(s), ball(s, c, r)), pts(s))

bdd-metric

bdd-metric(s) := [pts(s), vnb-lambda([u, v], cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), (/)((dist(s))(u, v), 1 + (dist(s))(u, v)))]

bernstein-basis

bernstein-basis(n, x) := comb-kk(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field), x, 1 - x, n)

bernstein-poly

bernstein-poly(f, n, x) := series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(l_, nn, f((/)(l_, n)) * (bernstein-basis(n, x))(l_)), succ(n))

bh-act

bh-act(bov_) := vnb-lambda([boc_, bot_], cartesian(cc, bounded-ops(bov_, bov_)), bop-scale(bov_, bov_, boc_, bot_))

bh-algebra

bh-algebra(bov_) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(bov_, bov_), bh-vadd(bov_), bop-zero(bov_, bov_), bh-vneg(bov_), bh-act(bov_), bh-vnrm(bov_), bh-vmul(bov_), bop-id(bov_), bh-vstar(bov_)]

bh-module

bh-module(otv_) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(otv_, otv_), bh-vadd(otv_), bop-zero(otv_, otv_), bh-vneg(otv_), bh-act(otv_)]

bh-vadd

bh-vadd(bov_) := vnb-lambda([bos_, bot_], cartesian(bounded-ops(bov_, bov_), bounded-ops(bov_, bov_)), bop-sum(bov_, bov_, bos_, bot_))

bh-vmul

bh-vmul(bov_) := vnb-lambda([bos_, bot_], cartesian(bounded-ops(bov_, bov_), bounded-ops(bov_, bov_)), bop-comp(bov_, bos_, bot_))

bh-vneg

bh-vneg(bov_) := vnb-lambda(bot_, bounded-ops(bov_, bov_), bop-neg(bov_, bov_, bot_))

bh-vnrm

bh-vnrm(bov_) := vnb-lambda(bot_, bounded-ops(bov_, bov_), opnorm(bov_, bov_, bot_))

bh-vstar

bh-vstar(bov_) := vnb-lambda(bot_, bounded-ops(bov_, bov_), op-adjoint(bov_, bov_, bot_))

bichar-of

bichar-of(chk_, chc_, cha_) := vnb-lambda([chu_, chv_], cartesian(carr(chk_), carr(chk_)), chc_((mul(chk_))(cha_, (mul(chk_))(chu_, chv_))))

bichar-polar

bichar-polar(c5k_, c5w_, c5v_) := {c5h_ in carr(c5k_): forall([c5x_ in c5v_], c5w_(c5h_, c5x_) = 1)}

bicommutant

bicommutant(vnv_, vns_) := commutant(vnv_, commutant(vnv_, vns_))

bidual-eval

bidual-eval(m, x) := vnb-lambda(bdef_, dual-vec(m), bdef_(x))

bk-f

bk-f(bfg_, bfv_, bfx_) := subadd-reg(grp-monoid(bfg_), vnb-lambda(bfz_, carr(bfg_), bk-gauge(bfv_, bfz_)), bfx_)

bk-gauge

bk-gauge(bgv_, bgx_) := einf({bgr_ in rr: forsome([bgk_ in nn], bgx_ in bgv_(bgk_) and bgr_ = num(1/2) ^ bgk_)})

bk-metric

bk-metric(bmg_, bmv_) := [carr(bmg_), vnb-lambda([bmx_, bmy_], cartesian(carr(bmg_), carr(bmg_)), bk-f(bmg_, bmv_, (opr(bmg_))((inv(bmg_))(bmy_), bmx_)) + bk-f(bmg_, bmv_, (opr(bmg_))((inv(bmg_))(bmx_), bmy_)))]

block

block(p, k, l) := matof(k, l, vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, k), interval(1, l)), entry(p, i, j)))

bop-comp

bop-comp(bov_, bos_, bot_) := vnb-lambda(box_, vec(bov_), bos_(bot_(box_)))

bop-id

bop-id(bov_) := vnb-lambda(box_, vec(bov_), box_)

bop-neg

bop-neg(bov_, bow_, bot_) := vnb-lambda(box_, vec(bov_), (vneg(bow_))(bot_(box_)))

bop-normed-ag

bop-normed-ag(bov_, bow_) := [bounded-ops(bov_, bow_), bop-vadd(bov_, bow_), bop-zero(bov_, bow_), bop-vinv(bov_, bow_), bop-vnrm(bov_, bow_)]

bop-scale

bop-scale(bov_, bow_, boc_, bot_) := vnb-lambda(box_, vec(bov_), (act(bow_))(boc_, bot_(box_)))

bop-sum

bop-sum(bov_, bow_, bos_, bot_) := vnb-lambda(box_, vec(bov_), (vadd(bow_))(bos_(box_), bot_(box_)))

bop-vadd

bop-vadd(bov_, bow_) := vnb-lambda([bos_, bot_], cartesian(bounded-ops(bov_, bow_), bounded-ops(bov_, bow_)), bop-sum(bov_, bow_, bos_, bot_))

bop-vinv

bop-vinv(bov_, bow_) := vnb-lambda(bot_, bounded-ops(bov_, bow_), bop-neg(bov_, bow_, bot_))

bop-vnrm

bop-vnrm(bov_, bow_) := vnb-lambda(bot_, bounded-ops(bov_, bow_), opnorm(bov_, bow_, bot_))

bop-zero

bop-zero(bov_, bow_) := vnb-lambda(box_, vec(bov_), vzero(bow_))

border

border(a, b, m, p, q) := matof(succ(p), succ(q), vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, succ(p)), interval(1, succ(q))), if(i = 1, if(j = 1, b, zero(a)), if(j = 1, zero(a), entry(m, nn-minus(i, 1), nn-minus(j, 1))))))

borel-sets

borel-sets(m) := sigma-generated(pts(m), {mou_ in power(pts(m)): is-open(m, mou_)})

bounded-ops

bounded-ops(bov_, bow_) := {bot_ in fun(vec(bov_), vec(bow_)): is-bounded-op(bov_, bow_, bot_)}

c-int

c-int(phi, a, b) := iota(v_, v_ in rr and forsome([f_], is-antiderivative(f_, phi, a, b) and v_ = f_(b) - f_(a)))

c-int-or

c-int-or(phi, a, b) := if(is-antiderivable(phi, a, b), c-int(phi, a, b), if(is-antiderivable(phi, b, a), -c-int(phi, b, a), 0))

c-metric

c-metric(s) := c-metric-w(s, vnb-lambda(n, nn, (/)(1, 2 ^ (n + 1))))

c-metric-w

c-metric-w(s, w) := [pts(s), vnb-lambda([u, v], cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), iota(l, l in rr and series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(k, nn, w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(u, v))), l)))]

c-pseudo-family

c-pseudo-family(s) := vnb-lambda(k, nn, [pts(s), (dists(s))(k)])

cact

cact(v) := vnb-lambda([cxz_, cxx_], cartesian(cc, vec(v)), (vadd(v))((act(v))(real-part(cxz_), cxx_), (act(v))(imag-part(cxz_), (jop(v))(cxx_))))

canon-onb

canon-onb(kqv_) := choice(onb-sets(kqv_))

caratheodory-sets

caratheodory-sets(omega, mu) := {es_ in power(omega): is-caratheodory-measurable(omega, mu, es_)}

card

card(a_) := iota(alpha, alpha in ord and forsome([phi], phi in bijection(a_, ord-segment(alpha))) and forall([beta], ord-lt(beta, alpha) implies not(forsome([psi], psi in bijection(a_, ord-segment(beta))))))

cauchy-setoid

cauchy-setoid(m) := [cseq(m), crel(m)]

cayley-graph

cayley-graph(ubv_, ubg_) := {ubp_ in cartesian(vec(ubv_), vec(ubv_)): forsome([ubq_ in ubg_], ubp_ = [(vadd(ubv_))((act(ubv_))(1i, nth(1, ubq_)), nth(2, ubq_)), (vadd(ubv_))((act(ubv_))(-1i, nth(1, ubq_)), nth(2, ubq_))])}

cbop-comp

cbop-comp(cqu_, cqs_, cqt_) := vnb-lambda(cqx_, vec(cqu_), cqs_(cqt_(cqx_)))

cbop-id

cbop-id(cqu_) := vnb-lambda(cqx_, vec(cqu_), cqx_)

cbop-neg

cbop-neg(cbv_, cbw_, cbt_) := vnb-lambda(cbx_, vec(cbv_), (vneg(cbw_))(cbt_(cbx_)))

cbop-normed-ag

cbop-normed-ag(cbv_, cbw_) := [cnvs-bounded-ops(cbv_, cbw_), cbop-vadd(cbv_, cbw_), cbop-zero(cbv_, cbw_), cbop-vinv(cbv_, cbw_), cbop-vnrm(cbv_, cbw_)]

cbop-scale

cbop-scale(cbv_, cbw_, cbc_, cbt_) := vnb-lambda(cbx_, vec(cbv_), (cact(cbw_))(cbc_, cbt_(cbx_)))

cbop-sum

cbop-sum(cbv_, cbw_, cbs_, cbt_) := vnb-lambda(cbx_, vec(cbv_), (vadd(cbw_))(cbs_(cbx_), cbt_(cbx_)))

cbop-vadd

cbop-vadd(cbv_, cbw_) := vnb-lambda([cbs_, cbt_], cartesian(cnvs-bounded-ops(cbv_, cbw_), cnvs-bounded-ops(cbv_, cbw_)), cbop-sum(cbv_, cbw_, cbs_, cbt_))

cbop-vinv

cbop-vinv(cbv_, cbw_) := vnb-lambda(cbt_, cnvs-bounded-ops(cbv_, cbw_), cbop-neg(cbv_, cbw_, cbt_))

cbop-vnrm

cbop-vnrm(cbv_, cbw_) := vnb-lambda(cbt_, cnvs-bounded-ops(cbv_, cbw_), cnvs-opnorm(cbv_, cbw_, cbt_))

cbop-zero

cbop-zero(cbv_, cbw_) := vnb-lambda(cbx_, vec(cbv_), vzero(cbw_))

cc-cont-fns

cc-cont-fns(u) := {ccf_ in fun(u, cc): forall([ccy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), ccf_, ccy_))}

cc-cos

cc-cos(z) := cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, (num(-1) ^ cek_ * recip(factorial(2 * cek_))) * z ^ (2 * cek_)))

cc-exhaust

cc-exhaust(u, n) := {cxz_ in cc: magnitude(cxz_) <= n and ball(cc-ms, cxz_, recip(n + 1)) subset u}

cc-exhaust-seminorms

cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, v) := vnb-lambda(cfk_, nn, vnb-lambda(cfa_, v, cc-sup-norm(cfa_, cc-exhaust(u, cfk_))))

cc-exp

cc-exp(z) := cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, recip(factorial(cek_)) * z ^ cek_))

cc-family-sum

cc-family-sum(f) := choice({csw_ in cc: sums-to(cc-nag, f, csw_)})

cc-fn-module

cc-fn-module(u, v) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), v, vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(v, v), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0), vnb-lambda(cfa_, v, vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, -cfa_(cfz_))), vnb-lambda([cfc_, cfa_], cartesian(cc, v), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfc_ * cfa_(cfz_)))]

cc-fraction-field

cc-fraction-field(aa) := {anfq_ in cc: forsome([anfa_ in aa, anfb_ in aa], not(anfb_ = 0) and anfq_ * anfb_ = anfa_)}

cc-hol-fns

cc-hol-fns(u) := {ccf_ in fun(u, cc): holomorphic-on(u, ccf_)}

cc-int

cc-int(pphi_, a, b) := pw-int(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) + pw-int(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) * 1i

cc-lincomb

cc-lincomb(n, b, g) := finsum(ring-additive-ag(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), vnb-lambda(almj_, interval(1, n), b(almj_) * g(almj_)), interval(1, n))

cc-line

cc-line(clnp_, clnd_) := {clnz_ in cc: imag-part((clnz_ - clnp_) * conjugate(clnd_)) = 0}

cc-log

cc-log(clgw_) := iota(clgz_, clgz_ in cc and -pi < imag-part(clgz_) and imag-part(clgz_) < pi and cc-exp(clgz_) = clgw_)

cc-matrix-of

cc-matrix-of(a, b) := [[a, b], [-b, a]]

cc-mid

cc-mid(cmx_, cmy_) := (cmx_ + cmy_) * recip(2)

cc-series-limit

cc-series-limit(f) := iota(cpsl_, cc-series-converges-to(f, cpsl_))

cc-series-partial-sum

cc-series-partial-sum(f, k) := sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(cc-normed-field), f, k)

cc-sin

cc-sin(z) := cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, (num(-1) ^ cek_ * recip(factorial(succ(2 * cek_)))) * z ^ succ(2 * cek_)))

cc-sup-norm

cc-sup-norm(u, cpsxs_) := esup(image(vnb-lambda(cpsx_, cpsxs_, magnitude(u(cpsx_))), cpsxs_))

ccint

ccint(a, b) := {x in rr: a <= x and x <= b}

ccont

ccont(kxt_) := {kxf_ in fun(pts(kxt_), cc): is-hom-top-space(kxt_, metric-top(cc-ms), kxf_)}

ccont-act

ccont-act(kxt_) := vnb-lambda([kxc_, kxf_], cartesian(cc, ccont(kxt_)), vnb-lambda(kxp_, pts(kxt_), kxc_ * kxf_(kxp_)))

ccont-algebra

ccont-algebra(kxt_) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), ccont(kxt_), ccont-vadd(kxt_), ccont-vzero(kxt_), ccont-vneg(kxt_), ccont-act(kxt_), ccont-vnrm(kxt_), ccont-vmul(kxt_), ccont-vone(kxt_), ccont-vstar(kxt_)]

ccont-vadd

ccont-vadd(kxt_) := vnb-lambda([kxf_, kxg_], cartesian(ccont(kxt_), ccont(kxt_)), vnb-lambda(kxp_, pts(kxt_), kxf_(kxp_) + kxg_(kxp_)))

ccont-vmul

ccont-vmul(kxt_) := vnb-lambda([kxf_, kxg_], cartesian(ccont(kxt_), ccont(kxt_)), vnb-lambda(kxp_, pts(kxt_), kxf_(kxp_) * kxg_(kxp_)))

ccont-vneg

ccont-vneg(kxt_) := vnb-lambda(kxf_, ccont(kxt_), vnb-lambda(kxp_, pts(kxt_), -kxf_(kxp_)))

ccont-vnrm

ccont-vnrm(kxt_) := vnb-lambda(kxf_, ccont(kxt_), sup-norm-t(kxt_, kxf_))

ccont-vone

ccont-vone(kxt_) := vnb-lambda(kxp_, pts(kxt_), 1)

ccont-vstar

ccont-vstar(kxt_) := vnb-lambda(kxf_, ccont(kxt_), vnb-lambda(kxp_, pts(kxt_), conjugate(kxf_(kxp_))))

ccont-vzero

ccont-vzero(kxt_) := vnb-lambda(kxp_, pts(kxt_), 0)

cdual-norm

cdual-norm(baa_, baf_) := esup(image(vnb-lambda(bdx_, {bdy_ in vec(baa_): (vnrm(baa_))(bdy_) <= 1}, magnitude(baf_(bdx_))), {bdy_ in vec(baa_): (vnrm(baa_))(bdy_) <= 1}))

cdual-vec

cdual-vec(baa_) := {baf_ in fun(vec(baa_), cc): is-cc-linear-on(baa_, baf_) and forsome([bam_ in rr], forall([bax_ in vec(baa_)], magnitude(baf_(bax_)) <= bam_ * (vnrm(baa_))(bax_)))}

centre-set

centre-set(s, r, f) := image(vnb-lambda(b, f, choice(centres(s, b, r))), f)

centres

centres(s, b, r) := {c in pts(s): ball(s, c, r) = b}

cert-set

elem-f

elem-f(a, n, k, l) := matof(n, n, vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, n)), if(i = k and j = l or i = l and j = k or i = j and not(i = k) and not(i = l), one(a), zero(a))))

elem-g

elem-g(a, n, r, k, l) := matof(n, n, vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, n)), if(i = j, one(a), if(i = k and j = l, r, zero(a)))))

elem-gen

elem-gen(r, n) := intersection-of({egs_ in power(mat(n, n, carr(r))): identmat(r, n) in egs_ and forall([egx_ in egs_, ege_ in set], is-elementary(r, n, ege_) implies matmul(r, egx_, ege_) in egs_)})

elem-h

elem-h(a, n, r, k) := matof(n, n, vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, n)), if(i = j, if(i = k, r, one(a)), zero(a))))

eliminf

eliminf(f) := esup(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, einf(etail(f, n_))), nn))

elimsup

elimsup(f) := einf(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, esup(etail(f, n_))), nn))

elower-bounds

elower-bounds(s) := {b_ in rr-pos-star: forall([x_ in s], b_ <= x_)}

embed

embed(m) := vnb-lambda(u, pts(m), class(cauchy-setoid(m), embed-seq(m, u)))

embed-seq

embed-seq(m, u) := vnb-lambda(n, nn, u)

enc-and

enc-apply

enc-bu

enc-cart

enc-cart(mcl_) := eapp(13, mcl_)

enc-comp

enc-comp(mcb_) := ebind(23, 1, [], mcb_)

enc-eq

enc-eq(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(8, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-ex

enc-ex(mcb_) := ebind(21, 1, [], mcb_)

enc-fun

enc-fun(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(19, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-fun1

enc-if

enc-iff

enc-iff(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(6, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-imp

enc-imp(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(5, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-in

enc-in(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(7, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-inter

enc-inter(mcl_) := eapp(12, mcl_)

enc-iota

enc-iota(mcb_) := ebind(25, 1, [], mcb_)

enc-lam

enc-lam(mca_, mcb_) := ebind(26, 1, [mca_], mcb_)

enc-le

enc-le(md10x_, md10y_) := eapp(10, [econst(11), md10x_, md10y_])

enc-length

enc-length(mcp_) := eapp(16, [mcp_])

enc-limit

enc-limit(mip_) := eapp(10, [econst(9), mip_])

enc-list

enc-list(mcl_) := eapp(17, mcl_)

enc-lt

enc-lt(md10x_, md10y_) := eapp(10, [econst(13), md10x_, md10y_])

enc-not

enc-nth

enc-nth(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(15, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-num

enc-or

enc-or(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(4, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-ordlt

enc-ordlt(mip_, miq_) := eapp(10, [econst(7), mip_, miq_])

enc-pred1

enc-pred1(md10n_, md10p_) := eapp(10, [md10n_, md10p_])

enc-qeq

enc-qeq(mcp_, mcq_) := eapp(9, [mcp_, mcq_])

enc-sep

enc-sep(mca_, mcb_) := ebind(22, 1, [mca_], mcb_)

enc-succ

enc-succ(mip_) := eapp(30, [mip_])

enc-succo

enc-succo(mip_) := eapp(31, [mip_])

enc-tuples

enc-tuples(mcp_) := eapp(14, [mcp_])

enc-union

enc-union(mcl_) := eapp(11, mcl_)

encr

encr(smg_, smk_) := [2, smg_, smk_]

entry

entry(m, i, j) := nth(j, nth(i, m))

enum-fam

enum-fam(ag, f, phi, n) := vnb-lambda(i, nn, if(i in ord-segment(n), f(phi(i)), iden(ag)))

ep-norm

ep-norm(omega, ca, mu, epp_, epf_) := epow(integral(omega, ca, mu, ptwise-epow(omega, epf_, epp_)), recip(epp_))

eplus-down

eplus-down(edx_, edy_) := if(edx_ = neg-inf or edy_ = neg-inf, neg-inf, edx_ + edy_)

eplus-up

eplus-up(eux_, euy_) := if(eux_ = pos-inf or euy_ = pos-inf, pos-inf, eux_ + euy_)

epow

epow(ept_, epp_) := if(ept_ = pos-inf, pos-inf, rpow-star(ept_, epp_))

eps-rel

eps-rel(cuvs_, cuve_) := {cuvp_ in cartesian(pts(cuvs_), pts(cuvs_)): (dist(cuvs_))(nth(1, cuvp_), nth(2, cuvp_)) < cuve_}

eps-setoid

eps-setoid(cuvs_, cuve_) := [pts(cuvs_), eps-rel(cuvs_, cuve_)]

eqv

eqv(mrt_) := {mrx_ in rw-univ: eqv-ok(mrt_, mrx_)}

esum

esum(f_) := esup({v_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([t_], (t_ in set and card(t_) in nn and t_ subset dom(f_)) and v_ = finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f_, t_))})

esup

esup(s_) := iota(bb_, bb_ in rr-pos-star and forall([x in s_], x <= bb_) and forall([b], b in rr-pos-star and forall([x in s_], x <= b) implies bb_ <= b))

etail

etail(f, n) := image(f, {p_ in nn: n <= p_})

euclidean-gauges

euclidean-gauges(s) := {dg in fun(carr(s), nn): has-div-remainder(s, dg)}

euler-phi

euler-phi(n) := card({ephk_ in interval(1, n): zz-coprime(ephk_, n)})

ev-op

ev-op(gev-md_, gev-t_) := vnb-lambda(gevp_, carr(poly(scal(gev-md_))), op-of(gev-md_, gev-t_, gevp_))

eval-at-points

eval-at-points(a, th, m) := vnb-lambda(gep_, poly-le(a, m), vnb-lambda(gei_, interval(1, succ(m)), poly-eval(a, gep_, th(gei_))))

ex-spine

ex-spine(mnbb_) := {mnbz_ in cartesian(expr-set, nn): forall([mnbv_ in power(cartesian(expr-set, nn))], [mnbb_, 0] in mnbv_ implies ex-spine-closed(mnbv_) implies mnbz_ in mnbv_)}

expr-fv

expr-fv(mxe_) := (fv-stage(expr-rank(mxe_)))(mxe_)

expr-lcd

expr-lcd(mxe_) := (lcd-stage(expr-rank(mxe_)))(mxe_)

expr-open

expr-open(mxe_, mxk_, mxu_) := (open-stage(mxu_, expr-rank(mxe_)))(mxe_, mxk_)

expr-rank

expr-rank(mxe_) := iota(mxr_, mxr_ in nn and mxe_ in expr-stage(mxr_) and forall([mxj_ in nn], mxe_ in expr-stage(mxj_) implies mxr_ <= mxj_))

expr-subst

expr-subst(mxe_, mxm_, mxu_) := (subst-stage(mxm_, mxu_, expr-rank(mxe_)))(mxe_)

expr-wks

expr-wks(mce_) := (wks-stage(expr-rank(mce_)))(mce_)

ext-abs

ext-abs(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4xi_) := (fnrm(x4k_))(ext-norm(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4xi_))

ext-abs-root

ext-abs-root(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4xi_) := rpow-star(ext-abs(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4xi_), recip-star(x4n_))

ext-add

ext-add(eax_, eay_) := if(eax_ = pos-inf or eay_ = pos-inf, pos-inf, if(eax_ = neg-inf or eay_ = neg-inf, neg-inf, eax_ + eay_))

ext-degree

ext-degree(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_) := iota(x4d_, forsome([x4b_], is-fin-ext(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4d_, x4b_)))

ext-neg

ext-neg(enx_) := if(enx_ = pos-inf, neg-inf, if(enx_ = neg-inf, pos-inf, -enx_))

ext-norm

ext-norm(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4xi_) := det(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(x4k_), x4n_, mult-mat(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4f_, x4xi_))

ext-partial-sum

ext-partial-sum(x, n) := if(forsome([epk_ in nn], epk_ < n and x(epk_) = pos-inf), pos-inf, if(forsome([epk_ in nn], epk_ < n and x(epk_) = neg-inf), neg-inf, series-partial-sum(x, n)))

ext-sub

ext-sub(esx_, esy_) := ext-add(esx_, ext-neg(esy_))

extend-const

extend-const(f, a, b) := vnb-lambda(ecx_, rr, f(clamp(a, b, ecx_)))

extreme-points

extreme-points(m, ks) := {kez_ in vec(m): is-extreme-point(m, ks, kez_)}

fact-sums

fact-sums(fsm_, fsg_, fsx_) := {fsr_ in rr: forsome([fsn_ in nn, fsu_ in fun(nn, carr(fsm_))], mprod(fsm_, fsu_, fsn_) = fsx_ and fsr_ = series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(fsi_, nn, fsg_(fsu_(fsi_))), fsn_))}

fin-enum

fin-enum(s) := choice(bijection(ord-segment(card(s)), s))

fin-subset-monoid

fin-subset-monoid(a_) := [fin-subsets(a_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(fin-subsets(a_), fin-subsets(a_)), union(x_, y_)), empty-set]

fin-subsets

fin-subsets(a_) := {t_ in power(a_): card(t_) in nn}

finite-rank-ops

finite-rank-ops(kqv_, kqw_) := {kqt_ in bounded-ops(kqv_, kqw_): is-finite-rank-op(kqv_, kqw_, kqt_)}

finite-unions

finite-unions(omega, ci) := {mfu_ in power(omega): forsome([mff_ in set], card(mff_) in nn and mff_ subset ci and mfu_ = big-union(mfw_, mff_, mfw_))}

finprod

finprod(m, f, s) := finsum(m, f, s)

finsum

finsum(ag, f, s) := sum-ag(ag, enum-fam(ag, f, fin-enum(s), card(s)), card(s))

finsupp

finsupp(a, m) := {f in fun(carr(m), carr(a)): card(supp(a, m, f)) in nn}

fker

fker(m, f) := {fkz_ in vec(m): f(fkz_) = 0}

fn-x-section

fn-x-section(ys, f, x) := vnb-lambda(fsy_, ys, f([x, fsy_]))

fn-y-section

form-cseq

form-cseq(md, fq) := cseq(form-ms(md, fq))

form-ms

form-ms(md, fq) := ip-metric-space(module-with-form(md, fq))

form-null

form-null(ipfm_, ipff_) := {ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_): ipff_(ipfx_, ipfx_) = 0}

form-operator

form-operator(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) := {ubp_ in cartesian(vec(ubv_), vec(ubv_)): nth(1, ubp_) in ubd_ and forall([ubx_ in ubd_], (ip(ubv_))(ubx_, nth(2, ubp_)) = ubf_(ubx_, nth(1, ubp_)))}

form-plus

form-plus(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) := vnb-lambda([ubx_, uby_], cartesian(ubd_, ubd_), ubf_(ubx_, uby_) + (ip(ubv_))(ubx_, uby_))

form-plus-space

form-plus-space(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), ubd_, vnb-lambda([ubx_, uby_], cartesian(ubd_, ubd_), (vadd(ubv_))(ubx_, uby_)), vzero(ubv_), vnb-lambda(ubx_, ubd_, (vneg(ubv_))(ubx_)), vnb-lambda([ubk_, ubx_], cartesian(cc, ubd_), (act(ubv_))(ubk_, ubx_)), form-plus(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_)]

form-qip

form-qip(ipfm_, ipff_) := descend2(qmod-setoid(ipfm_, form-null(ipfm_, ipff_)), ipff_)

form-quotient

form-quotient(ipfm_, ipff_) := module-with-form(quotient-module(ipfm_, form-null(ipfm_, ipff_)), form-qip(ipfm_, ipff_))

fp

fp(qsp_) := ringoid-quotient-ring(fp-ringoid(qsp_))

fp-ringoid

fp-ringoid(qsp_) := [zz, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, zz, -x_), 0, 1, {fpn_ in zz: zz-divides(qsp_, fpn_)}]

fr-ball

fr-ball(m, fam, n, eps) := {x in vec(m): forall([k], k in nn and k <= n implies (fam(k))(x) < eps)}

fr-c-space

fr-metric

fr-metric(m, fam) := dist(fr-metric-space(m, fam))

fr-metric-space

fr-metric-space(m, fam) := c-metric(fr-c-space(m, fam))

gamma-ext

gamma-ext(gez_) := gamma-function(gez_ + choice({gek_ in nn: 0 < real-part(gez_) + gek_})) * recip(poch(gez_, choice({gek_ in nn: 0 < real-part(gez_) + gek_})))

gamma-function

gamma-function(gmz_) := improper-int(gamma-integrand(gmz_))

gamma-integrand

gamma-integrand(gmz_) := vnb-lambda(gmw_, {gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, cc-exp((gmz_ - 1) * cc-log(gmw_)) * cc-exp(-gmw_))

gauge

gauge(s) := choice(euclidean-gauges(s))

gelfand-dual-map

gelfand-dual-map(baa_, bab_, baf_) := vnb-lambda(bgw_, characters(bab_), vnb-lambda(bgx_, vec(baa_), bgw_(baf_(bgx_))))

gelfand-space

gelfand-space(baa_) := subspace-top(tproduct-top(vec(baa_), vnb-lambda(bgx_, vec(baa_), metric-top(cc-ms))), characters(baa_))

gelfand-transform

gelfand-transform(baa_) := vnb-lambda(bgx_, vec(baa_), vnb-lambda(bgc_, characters(baa_), bgc_(bgx_)))

generated-subgroup

generated-subgroup(gcg_, gcx_) := {gcy_ in carr(gcg_): forall([gcs_ in power(carr(gcg_))], is-subgroup(gcg_, gcs_) implies gcx_ in gcs_ implies gcy_ in gcs_)}

gns-form

gns-form(g4ga_, g4gf_) := vnb-lambda([g4gx_, g4gy_], cartesian(vec(g4ga_), vec(g4ga_)), g4gf_((vmul(g4ga_))((vstar(g4ga_))(g4gy_), g4gx_)))

gns-module

gns-module(g4ga_) := uba-as-module(uiba-as-uba(g4ga_))

gns-op

gns-op(g4ga_, g4gf_, g4gx_) := descend(gns-setoid(g4ga_, g4gf_), vnb-lambda(g4gb_, vec(g4ga_), class(gns-setoid(g4ga_, g4gf_), (vmul(g4ga_))(g4gx_, g4gb_))))

gns-pre

gns-pre(g4ga_, g4gf_) := form-quotient(gns-module(g4ga_), gns-form(g4ga_, g4gf_))

gns-setoid

gns-setoid(g4ga_, g4gf_) := qmod-setoid(gns-module(g4ga_), form-null(gns-module(g4ga_), gns-form(g4ga_, g4gf_)))

gns-vector

graph-adjoint

graph-adjoint(ubv_, ubg_) := {ubp_ in cartesian(vec(ubv_), vec(ubv_)): forall([ubq_ in ubg_], (ip(ubv_))(nth(1, ubq_), nth(2, ubp_)) = (ip(ubv_))(nth(2, ubq_), nth(1, ubp_)))}

graph-closure

graph-closure(ubv_, ubg_) := closure(ip-metric-space(hsum(ubv_, ubv_)), ubg_)

graph-compose

graph-compose(ubv_, ubg_, ubh_) := {ubp_ in cartesian(vec(ubv_), vec(ubv_)): forsome([uby_ in vec(ubv_)], [nth(1, ubp_), uby_] in ubh_ and [uby_, nth(2, ubp_)] in ubg_)}

graph-dom

graph-dom(ubv_, ubg_) := {ubx_ in vec(ubv_): forsome([uby_ in vec(ubv_)], [ubx_, uby_] in ubg_)}

graph-inverse

graph-inverse(ubv_, ubg_) := {ubp_ in cartesian(vec(ubv_), vec(ubv_)): [nth(2, ubp_), nth(1, ubp_)] in ubg_}

graph-j

graph-j(ubv_, ubg_) := {ubp_ in cartesian(vec(ubv_), vec(ubv_)): [nth(2, ubp_), (vneg(ubv_))(nth(1, ubp_))] in ubg_}

graph-ms

graph-ms(s, a, g) := [a, vnb-lambda([gmu_, gmv_], cartesian(a, a), (dist(s))(gmu_, gmv_) + abs(g(gmu_) - g(gmv_)))]

graph-of

graph-of(gfx_, gfy_, gff_) := {grp_ in cartesian(gfx_, gfy_): gff_(nth(1, grp_)) = nth(2, grp_)}

graph-ran

graph-ran(ubv_, ubg_) := {uby_ in vec(ubv_): forsome([ubx_ in vec(ubv_)], [ubx_, uby_] in ubg_)}

greedy-chain

greedy-chain(phi, grd, porel) := zkept(phi, grd, porel, card(grd))

group-prod

group-prod(x, y) := [cartesian(carr(x), carr(y)), vnb-lambda([gpp_, gpq_], cartesian(cartesian(carr(x), carr(y)), cartesian(carr(x), carr(y))), [(opr(x))(nth(1, gpp_), nth(1, gpq_)), (opr(y))(nth(2, gpp_), nth(2, gpq_))]), [iden(x), iden(y)], vnb-lambda(gpp_, cartesian(carr(x), carr(y)), [(inv(x))(nth(1, gpp_)), (inv(y))(nth(2, gpp_))])]

group-zpow

group-zpow(g, x, k) := if(0 <= k, gpow(g, x, k), (inv(g))(gpow(g, x, 0 - k)))

grp-monoid
