haar-averages

haar-averages(hag_) := {haq_ in fun(cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_)), cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_))): forall([hau_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_)), hav_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_))], haq_((vadd(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hag_))))(hau_, hav_)) = (vadd(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hag_))))(haq_(hau_), haq_(hav_))) and forall([har_ in rr, hau_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_))], haq_((act(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hag_))))(har_, hau_)) = (act(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hag_))))(har_, haq_(hau_))) and forall([hau_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_)), hav_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_))], (dist(nvs-metric-space(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hag_)))))(haq_(hau_), haq_(hav_)) <= (dist(nvs-metric-space(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hag_)))))(hau_, hav_)) and forall([hac_ in rr], haq_(vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hag_)), hac_)) = vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hag_)), hac_)) and forall([hau_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_))], haq_(hau_) in conv-hull(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hag_)), image(vnb-lambda(hqa_, pts(metric-group-ms(hag_)), vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hag_)), hau_((opr(hag_))(hqa_, hix_)))), pts(metric-group-ms(hag_))))) and forall([hab_ in pts(metric-group-ms(hag_)), hau_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hag_))], haq_(vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hag_)), hau_((opr(hag_))(hix_, hab_)))) = vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hag_)), (haq_(hau_))((opr(hag_))(hix_, hab_))))}

haar-integral

haar-integral(hng_) := iota(hnu_, is-haar-integral(hng_, hnu_))

haar-mean

haar-mean(hmg_, hmf_) := iota(hmc_, hmc_ in rr and vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hmg_)), hmc_) in closure(nvs-metric-space(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hmg_))), conv-hull(ck-nvs(metric-group-ms(hmg_)), image(vnb-lambda(hqa_, pts(metric-group-ms(hmg_)), vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hmg_)), hmf_((opr(hmg_))(hqa_, hix_)))), pts(metric-group-ms(hmg_))))))

hausdorff

hausdorff(mhm_, mhl_) := method-ii(mhm_, power(pts(mhm_)), hausdorff-pm(mhm_, mhl_))

hausdorff-phi

hausdorff-phi(mhm_, mhf_) := method-ii(mhm_, power(pts(mhm_)), phi-pm(mhm_, mhf_))

hausdorff-pm

hausdorff-pm(mhm_, mhl_) := vnb-lambda(mhh_, power(pts(mhm_)), epow(diam(mhm_, mhh_), mhl_))

hc-embed

hc-embed(md, fq) := vnb-lambda(hcx_, vec(md), class(qmod-setoid(cseq-module(md, fq), form-null(cseq-module(md, fq), limit-form(md, fq))), embed-seq(form-ms(md, fq), hcx_)))

hd-argk

hd-argk(mch_) := if(mch_ <= 6, 2, 1)

hd-body

hd-body(mch_) := if(mch_ = 24 or mch_ = 26, 1, 2)

hd-bres

hd-bres(mch_) := if(mch_ <= 21, 2, 1)

hd-res

hd-res(mch_) := if(mch_ <= 10, 2, 1)

hilbert-completion

hilbert-completion(md, fq) := form-quotient(cseq-module(md, fq), limit-form(md, fq))

hom-abelian-group

hom-abelian-group(a, b) := {homf_ in fun(carr(a), carr(b)): is-hom-abelian-group(a, b, homf_)}

hom-bounded-linear

hom-bounded-linear(a, b) := {homf_ in fun(vec(a), vec(b)): is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, homf_)}

hom-bundle

hom-bundle(a, b) := {homf_ in fun(bnodes(a), bnodes(b)): is-hom-bundle(a, b, homf_)}

hom-c-continuous

keep-set(phi, grd, porel, kset, alpha) := {y in grd: y = phi(alpha) and forall([z in kset], [z, y] in porel)}

kernel-apply

kernel-apply(kaxs_, kays_, kacb_, kanu_, kak_, kaf_) := vnb-lambda(sgx_, kaxs_, if((x-section-integral(kaxs_, kays_, kacb_, kanu_, pos-part(cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), vnb-lambda(kpw_, cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), kak_(kpw_) * kaf_(nth(2, kpw_))))))(sgx_) in rr, (x-section-integral(kaxs_, kays_, kacb_, kanu_, pos-part(cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), vnb-lambda(kpw_, cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), kak_(kpw_) * kaf_(nth(2, kpw_))))))(sgx_), 0) - if((x-section-integral(kaxs_, kays_, kacb_, kanu_, neg-part(cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), vnb-lambda(kpw_, cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), kak_(kpw_) * kaf_(nth(2, kpw_))))))(sgx_) in rr, (x-section-integral(kaxs_, kays_, kacb_, kanu_, neg-part(cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), vnb-lambda(kpw_, cartesian(kaxs_, kays_), kak_(kpw_) * kaf_(nth(2, kpw_))))))(sgx_), 0))

key-ideal-gen

key-ideal-gen(sbgt_, sbgk_, sbgks_, sbgs_) := {sbgm_ in msg-set(sbgt_, sbgk_): forall([sbgq_ in power(msg-set(sbgt_, sbgk_))], is-key-ideal(sbgt_, sbgk_, sbgks_, sbgq_) implies forall([sbgz_ in sbgs_], sbgz_ in sbgq_) implies sbgm_ in sbgq_)}

krylov

krylov(gkr-md_, gkr-t_, gkr-v_, gkr-n_) := matof(gkr-n_, 1, vnb-lambda([gkri_, gkrj_], cartesian(interval(1, gkr-n_), interval(1, 1)), op-iter(gkr-md_, gkr-t_, gkr-v_, gkri_ - 1)))

krylov-mat

krylov-mat(k, n, tm, phi) := matof(n, n, vnb-lambda([zkvi_, zkvj_], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, n)), entry(matmul(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), mat-power(k, n, tm, zkvj_ - 1), phi), zkvi_, 1)))

l1-pairing

l1-pairing(omega, ca, mu, f) := vnb-lambda(lpg_, l1-set(omega, ca, mu), rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, f(sx_) * lpg_(sx_))))

l1-set

l1-set(omega, ca, mu) := {l1g_ in fun(omega, rr): is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, l1g_)}

l2-act

l2-act(omega, ca, mu) := vnb-lambda([lr_, lf_], cartesian(rr, l2-set(omega, ca, mu)), vnb-lambda(lx_, omega, lr_ * lf_(lx_)))

l2-cips

l2-cips(ix) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), l2-families(ix), l2f-vadd(ix), l2f-vzero(ix), l2f-vneg(ix), l2f-act(ix), l2-ip(ix)]

l2-families

l2-families(ix) := {l2c_ in fun(ix, cc): esum(vnb-lambda(l2k_, ix, magnitude(l2c_(l2k_)) * magnitude(l2c_(l2k_)))) in rr}

l2-ip

l2-ip(ix) := vnb-lambda([l2a_, l2b_], cartesian(l2-families(ix), l2-families(ix)), cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(l2k_, ix, l2a_(l2k_) * conjugate(l2b_(l2k_)))))

l2-rip

l2-rip(omega, ca, mu) := vnb-lambda([lf_, lg_], cartesian(l2-set(omega, ca, mu), l2-set(omega, ca, mu)), rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(lx_, omega, lf_(lx_) * lg_(lx_))))

l2-set

l2-set(omega, ca, mu) := {lf_ in fun(omega, rr): is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, lf_) and is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(lx_, omega, lf_(lx_) * lf_(lx_)))}

l2-space

l2-space(omega, ca, mu) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field), l2-set(omega, ca, mu), l2-vadd(omega, ca, mu), l2-vzero(omega), l2-vneg(omega, ca, mu), l2-act(omega, ca, mu), l2-rip(omega, ca, mu)]

l2-vadd

l2-vadd(omega, ca, mu) := vnb-lambda([lf_, lg_], cartesian(l2-set(omega, ca, mu), l2-set(omega, ca, mu)), vnb-lambda(lx_, omega, lf_(lx_) + lg_(lx_)))

l2-vneg

l2-vneg(omega, ca, mu) := vnb-lambda(lf_, l2-set(omega, ca, mu), vnb-lambda(lx_, omega, -lf_(lx_)))

l2-vzero

l2-vzero(omega) := vnb-lambda(lx_, omega, 0)

l2f-act

l2f-act(ix) := vnb-lambda([l2z_, l2a_], cartesian(cc, l2-families(ix)), vnb-lambda(l2k_, ix, l2z_ * l2a_(l2k_)))

l2f-vadd

l2f-vadd(ix) := vnb-lambda([l2a_, l2b_], cartesian(l2-families(ix), l2-families(ix)), vnb-lambda(l2k_, ix, l2a_(l2k_) + l2b_(l2k_)))

l2f-vneg

l2f-vneg(ix) := vnb-lambda(l2a_, l2-families(ix), vnb-lambda(l2k_, ix, -l2a_(l2k_)))

l2f-vzero

l2f-vzero(ix) := vnb-lambda(l2k_, ix, 0)

lastcoeff-set

lastcoeff-set(md, p, u, sm) := {r_ in carr(scal(md)): forsome([c_ in mat(1, succ(p), carr(scal(md)))], entry(c_, 1, succ(p)) = r_ and lincomb(md, succ(p), c_, u) in sm)}

laurent-abs

laurent-abs(lrk_, lrr_, lrf_) := if(lrf_ = laurent-zero(lrk_), 0, rpow-star(lrr_, laurent-ord(lrk_, lrf_)))

laurent-add

laurent-add(lrk_, lrf_, lrg_) := vnb-lambda(lrj_, zz, (add(lrk_))(lrf_(lrj_), lrg_(lrj_)))

laurent-coefs

laurent-coefs(lcf_, lcc_, lcr_) := vnb-lambda(lck_, zz, if(0 <= lck_, recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(lcw_, trace(circle-path(lcc_, lcr_), 0, 2 * pi), lcf_(lcw_) * recip(lcw_ - lcc_) ^ succ(lck_)), circle-path(lcc_, lcr_), circle-deriv(lcc_, lcr_), 0, 2 * pi), recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(lcw_, trace(circle-path(lcc_, lcr_), 0, 2 * pi), lcf_(lcw_) * (lcw_ - lcc_) ^ (-(lck_ + 1))), circle-path(lcc_, lcr_), circle-deriv(lcc_, lcr_), 0, 2 * pi)))

laurent-ext

laurent-ext(llk_, llm_) := vnb-lambda(llw_, cartesian(laurent-polys(llk_, llm_), carr(llk_)), laurent-add(llk_, nth(1, llw_), laurent-mono(llk_, nth(2, llw_), llm_)))

laurent-inv-ser

laurent-inv-ser(lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_) := vnb-lambda(lrj_, zz, if(-lro_ <= lrj_, (laurent-inv-pre(lrk_, lrf_, lro_, lra_, lrj_ + lro_))(lrj_), zero(lrk_)))

laurent-lim

laurent-lim(llk_, lls_) := vnb-lambda(llj_, zz, laurent-limc(llk_, lls_, llj_))

laurent-limc

laurent-limc(llk_, lls_, llj_) := iota(llc_, llc_ in carr(llk_) and forsome([llm_ in nn], forall([lln_ in nn], llm_ <= lln_ implies (lls_(lln_))(llj_) = llc_)))

laurent-mono

laurent-mono(lrk_, lrc_, lrt_) := vnb-lambda(lrj_, zz, if(lrj_ = lrt_, lrc_, zero(lrk_)))

laurent-mul

laurent-mul(lrk_, lrf_, lrg_) := monalg-mul(lrk_, zz-add-monoid, lrf_, lrg_)

laurent-neg

laurent-neg(lrk_, lrf_) := vnb-lambda(lrj_, zz, (neg(lrk_))(lrf_(lrj_)))

laurent-nf

laurent-nf(lrk_, lrr_) := [carr(laurent-ring(lrk_)), add(laurent-ring(lrk_)), mul(laurent-ring(lrk_)), neg(laurent-ring(lrk_)), zero(laurent-ring(lrk_)), one(laurent-ring(lrk_)), vnb-lambda(lrf_, carr(laurent-ring(lrk_)), laurent-abs(lrk_, lrr_, lrf_))]

laurent-one

laurent-one(lrk_) := vnb-lambda(lrj_, zz, if(lrj_ = 0, one(lrk_), zero(lrk_)))

laurent-ord

laurent-ord(lrk_, lrf_) := iota(lro_, lro_ in zz and not(lrf_(lro_) = zero(lrk_)) and forall([lrj_ in zz], lrj_ < lro_ implies lrf_(lrj_) = zero(lrk_)))

laurent-pairing

laurent-pairing(a5k_, a5c_) := vnb-lambda([a5g_, a5f_], cartesian(laurent-set(a5k_), laurent-set(a5k_)), a5c_((laurent-mul(a5k_, a5f_, a5g_))(0)))

laurent-polys

laurent-polys(llk_, llm_) := {llg_ in fun(zz, carr(llk_)): forall([llj_ in zz], llj_ < 0 implies llg_(llj_) = zero(llk_)) and forall([llj_ in zz], llm_ <= llj_ implies llg_(llj_) = zero(llk_))}

laurent-ring

laurent-ring(lrk_) := [laurent-set(lrk_), vnb-lambda([lrf_, lrg_], cartesian(laurent-set(lrk_), laurent-set(lrk_)), laurent-add(lrk_, lrf_, lrg_)), vnb-lambda([lrf_, lrg_], cartesian(laurent-set(lrk_), laurent-set(lrk_)), laurent-mul(lrk_, lrf_, lrg_)), vnb-lambda(lrf_, laurent-set(lrk_), laurent-neg(lrk_, lrf_)), laurent-zero(lrk_), laurent-one(lrk_)]

laurent-set

laurent-set(lrk_) := {lrf_ in fun(zz, carr(lrk_)): is-laurent(lrk_, lrf_)}

laurent-sum

laurent-sum(lsc_, lsa_, lsz_) := cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(lsk_, nn, lsc_(lsk_) * (lsz_ - lsa_) ^ lsk_)) + recip(lsz_ - lsa_) * cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(lsk_, nn, lsc_(-(lsk_ + 1)) * recip(lsz_ - lsa_) ^ lsk_))

laurent-supp

laurent-supp(lrk_, lrf_) := {lrj_ in zz: not(lrf_(lrj_) = zero(lrk_))}

laurent-trunc

laurent-trunc(lrk_, lrf_, lrt_) := vnb-lambda(lrj_, zz, if(lrj_ <= lrt_, lrf_(lrj_), zero(lrk_)))

laurent-zero

laurent-zero(lrk_) := vnb-lambda(lrj_, zz, zero(lrk_))

ldir-deriv

ldir-deriv(ldm_, ldf_, lda_, lde_) := iota(ldl_, has-dir-deriv(ldm_, ldf_, lda_, lde_, ldl_))

leadcoef

leadcoef(a, p) := p(deg(a, p))

left-coset

left-coset(gcg_, gca_, gch_) := {gcx_ in carr(gcg_): forsome([gcy_ in gch_], gcx_ = (opr(gcg_))(gca_, gcy_))}

left-cosets

left-cosets(gcg_, gch_) := {gcc_ in power(carr(gcg_)): forsome([gca_ in carr(gcg_)], gcc_ = left-coset(gcg_, gca_, gch_))}

lft

lft(a, b, c, d) := vnb-lambda(lfz_, cc-hat, if(lfz_ = cc-inf, if(c = 0, cc-inf, a * recip(c)), if(c * lfz_ + d = 0, cc-inf, (a * lfz_ + b) * recip(c * lfz_ + d))))

limit-form

limit-form(md, fq) := vnb-lambda([hcf_, hcg_], cartesian(form-cseq(md, fq), form-cseq(md, fq)), iota(hcc_, hcc_ in cc and converges-to(cc-ms, seq-form(fq, hcf_, hcg_), hcc_)))

lin-coords

lin-coords(ndsm_, ndsd_, ndsu_, ndsp_, ndsv_) := iota(ndsc_, ndsc_ in mat(1, ndsd_, ndsp_) and ndsv_ = lincomb(ndsm_, ndsd_, ndsc_, ndsu_))

lin-span

lin-span(gls-md_, gls-n_, gls-u_) := {glsx_ in vec(gls-md_): forsome([glsc_ in mat(1, gls-n_, carr(scal(gls-md_)))], glsx_ = lincomb(gls-md_, gls-n_, glsc_, gls-u_))}

lincomb

lincomb(md, n, c, u) := finsum(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(j, interval(1, n), (act(md))(entry(c, 1, j), entry(u, j, 1))), interval(1, n))

line

line(m, v) := {y_ in vec(m): forsome([r_ in rr], y_ = (act(m))(r_, v))}

line-coef

line-coef(m, v, u) := iota(lnt_, lnt_ in rr and u = (act(m))(lnt_, v))

line-int

line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b) := cc-int(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)), a, b)

linf-norm

linf-norm(omega, ca, mu, f) := einf({lim_ in rr-pos-star: mu({lix_ in omega: lim_ < abs(f(lix_))}) = 0})

log

log(x_) := c-int-or(vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)), 1, x_)

lp-norm

lp-norm(omega, ca, mu, lpp_, lpf_) := ep-norm(omega, ca, mu, lpp_, abs-fn(omega, lpf_))

lst

lst(sml_) := [1, sml_]

make-metric-group

make-metric-group(mmm_, mmg_) := [carr(mmg_), opr(mmg_), iden(mmg_), inv(mmg_), dist(mmm_)]

make-top-group

make-top-group(mks_, mkg_) := [carr(mkg_), opr(mkg_), iden(mkg_), inv(mkg_), opens(mks_)]

map-seq

map-seq(h, n, u) := matof(n, 1, vnb-lambda([msa_, msb_], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, 1)), h(entry(u, msa_, msb_))))

mapl

mapl(mxf_, mxl_) := iota(mxr_, mxr_ in tuples(set) and length(mxr_) = length(mxl_) and forall([mxi_ in nn], 1 <= mxi_ implies mxi_ <= length(mxl_) implies nth(mxi_, mxr_) = mxf_(nth(mxi_, mxl_))))

maplk

maplk(mxf_, mxl_, mxk_) := iota(mxr_, mxr_ in tuples(set) and length(mxr_) = length(mxl_) and forall([mxi_ in nn], 1 <= mxi_ implies mxi_ <= length(mxl_) implies nth(mxi_, mxr_) = mxf_(nth(mxi_, mxl_), mxk_)))

mat

mat(m, n, x) := {p in matrix(x): n in nn and (length(p) = 0 implies m = 0) and (not(length(p) = 0) implies size(p) = [m, n])}

mat-act

mat-act(gma-md_, gma-n_, gma-p_, gma-u_) := matof(gma-n_, 1, vnb-lambda([gmai_, gmaj_], cartesian(interval(1, gma-n_), interval(1, 1)), finsum(module-vector-ag(gma-md_), vnb-lambda(gmak_, interval(1, gma-n_), (entry(gma-p_, gmai_, gmak_))(entry(gma-u_, gmak_, 1))), interval(1, gma-n_))))

mat-lft

mat-lft(s) := lft(entry(s, 1, 1), entry(s, 1, 2), entry(s, 2, 1), entry(s, 2, 2))

mat-map

mat-map(gmm-h_, gmm-m_, gmm-n_, gmm-a_) := matof(gmm-m_, gmm-n_, vnb-lambda([gmmi_, gmmj_], cartesian(interval(1, gmm-m_), interval(1, gmm-n_)), gmm-h_(entry(gmm-a_, gmmi_, gmmj_))))

mat-poly-eval

mat-poly-eval(k, n, p, tm) := sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(mat-ring(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), n)), vnb-lambda(zkvk_, nn, matscale(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), p(zkvk_), mat-power(k, n, tm, zkvk_))), succ(deg(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), p)))

mat-power

mat-power(k, n, tm, j) := mpow(ring-multiplicative-monoid(mat-ring(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), n)), tm, j)

mat-ring

mat-ring(a, n) := [mat(n, n, carr(a)), vnb-lambda([p, q], cartesian(mat(n, n, carr(a)), mat(n, n, carr(a))), matadd(a, p, q)), vnb-lambda([p, q], cartesian(mat(n, n, carr(a)), mat(n, n, carr(a))), matmul(a, p, q)), vnb-lambda(p, mat(n, n, carr(a)), matneg(a, p)), zeromat(a, n, n), identmat(a, n)]

matact

matact(md, p, u) := matof(nth(1, size(p)), nth(2, size(u)), vnb-lambda([i, c], cartesian(interval(1, nth(1, size(p))), interval(1, nth(2, size(u)))), finsum(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(j, interval(1, nth(2, size(p))), (act(md))(entry(p, i, j), entry(u, j, c))), interval(1, nth(2, size(p))))))

matadd

matadd(a, p, q) := matof(nth(1, size(p)), nth(2, size(p)), vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, nth(1, size(p))), interval(1, nth(2, size(p)))), (add(a))(entry(p, i, j), entry(q, i, j))))

matmul

matmul(a, p, q) := matof(nth(1, size(p)), nth(2, size(q)), vnb-lambda([i, k], cartesian(interval(1, nth(1, size(p))), interval(1, nth(2, size(q)))), finsum(ring-additive-ag(a), vnb-lambda(j, interval(1, nth(2, size(p))), (mul(a))(entry(p, i, j), entry(q, j, k))), interval(1, nth(2, size(p))))))

matneg

matneg(a, p) := matof(nth(1, size(p)), nth(2, size(p)), vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, nth(1, size(p))), interval(1, nth(2, size(p)))), (neg(a))(entry(p, i, j))))

matof

matof(m, n, g) := iota(p, p in mat(m, n, image(g, cartesian(interval(1, m), interval(1, n)))) and forall([i in interval(1, m), j in interval(1, n)], entry(p, i, j) = g(i, j)))

matscale

matscale(a, r, p) := matof(nth(1, size(p)), nth(2, size(p)), vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, nth(1, size(p))), interval(1, nth(2, size(p)))), (mul(a))(r, entry(p, i, j))))

matunit

matunit(a, n, k, l) := matof(n, n, vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, n)), if(i = k and j = l, one(a), zero(a))))

method-i-outer

method-i-outer(omega, cls, pm) := vnb-lambda(cve_, power(omega), einf(cover-sums(omega, cls, pm, cve_)))

method-ii

method-ii(mhm_, mhc_, mhp_) := vnb-lambda(mhe_, power(pts(mhm_)), esup({mhv_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([mhd_ in rr], pos-rr(mhd_) and mhv_ = (method-ii-delta(mhm_, mhc_, mhp_, mhd_))(mhe_))}))

method-ii-delta

method-ii-delta(mhm_, mhc_, mhp_, mhd_) := method-i-outer(pts(mhm_), {mha_ in mhc_: diam(mhm_, mha_) <= mhd_}, restrict(mhp_, {mha_ in mhc_: diam(mhm_, mha_) <= mhd_}))

metric-group-group

metric-group-group(mgr_) := [carr(mgr_), opr(mgr_), iden(mgr_), inv(mgr_)]

metric-group-ms

metric-group-ms(mgr_) := [carr(mgr_), gdist(mgr_)]

metric-top

metric-top(md) := [pts(md), {u in power(pts(md)): is-open(md, u)}]

mi-add

mi-add(x, u, v) := vnb-lambda(mia_, x, u(mia_) + v(mia_))

mi-reindex

mi-reindex(x, s, b) := vnb-lambda(mir_, x, b(s(mir_)))

mi-zero

mi-zero(x) := vnb-lambda(mia_, x, 0)

mink-set

mink-set(m, cs, x) := {mkr_ in rr: 0 < mkr_ and forsome([mky_ in cs], x = (act(m))(mkr_, mky_))}

minkowski-functional

minkowski-functional(m, cs) := vnb-lambda(mkx_, vec(m), inf(mink-set(m, cs, mkx_)))

minor

minor(s, r, c, n) := matof(n, n, vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, n)), entry(s, if(i < r, i, succ(i)), if(j < c, j, succ(j)))))

module-with-form

module-with-form(ipfm_, ipff_) := [scal(ipfm_), vec(ipfm_), vadd(ipfm_), vzero(ipfm_), vneg(ipfm_), act(ipfm_), ipff_]

monalg

monalg(a, m) := [finsupp(a, m), vnb-lambda([f, g], cartesian(finsupp(a, m), finsupp(a, m)), monalg-add(a, m, f, g)), vnb-lambda([f, g], cartesian(finsupp(a, m), finsupp(a, m)), monalg-mul(a, m, f, g)), vnb-lambda(f, finsupp(a, m), monalg-neg(a, m, f)), monalg-zero(a, m), monalg-one(a, m)]

monalg-add

monalg-add(a, m, f, g) := vnb-lambda(x_, carr(m), (add(a))(f(x_), g(x_)))

monalg-mul

monalg-mul(a, m, f, g) := vnb-lambda(x_, carr(m), finsum(ring-additive-ag(a), vnb-lambda(p, {p in cartesian(supp(a, m, f), supp(a, m, g)): (opr(m))(nth(1, p), nth(2, p)) = x_}, (mul(a))(f(nth(1, p)), g(nth(2, p)))), {p in cartesian(supp(a, m, f), supp(a, m, g)): (opr(m))(nth(1, p), nth(2, p)) = x_}))

monalg-neg

monalg-neg(a, m, f) := vnb-lambda(x_, carr(m), (neg(a))(f(x_)))

monalg-one

monalg-one(a, m) := vnb-lambda(x_, carr(m), if(x_ = iden(m), one(a), zero(a)))

monalg-pullback

monalg-pullback(a, m, ph, f) := vnb-lambda(mpx_, carr(m), f(ph(mpx_)))

monalg-zero

monalg-zero(a, m) := vnb-lambda(x_, carr(m), zero(a))

monic-poly

monic-poly(f, a, n) := vnb-lambda(gmk_, nn, if(gmk_ = n, one(f), if(gmk_ < n, a(succ(gmk_)), zero(f))))

monomial

monomial(a, c, n) := vnb-lambda(x_, nn, if(x_ = n, c, zero(a)))

monotone-class-generated

monotone-class-generated(omega, ce) := {mca_ in power(omega): forall([mcb_], mcb_ in power(power(omega)) and is-monotone-class(omega, mcb_) and ce subset mcb_ implies mca_ in mcb_)}

mpoly

mpoly(r, n) := monalg(r, multi-index-monoid(interval(1, n)))

msg-rank

msg-rank(smt_, smk_, smm_) := iota(smr_, smr_ in nn and smm_ in msg-stage(smt_, smk_, smr_) and forall([smj_ in nn], smm_ in msg-stage(smt_, smk_, smj_) implies smr_ <= smj_))

msg-set

msg-set(smt_, smk_) := big-union(smn_, nn, msg-stage(smt_, smk_, smn_))

mu-pinf

mu-pinf(prp_) := {mpz_ in cc: forsome([mpk_ in nn], mpz_ ^ prp_ ^ mpk_ = 1)}

mult-mat

mult-mat(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4f_, x4xi_) := op-mat(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, mult-op(x4f_, x4xi_))

mult-op

mult-op(x4f_, x4xi_) := vnb-lambda(x4p_, carr(x4f_), (mul(x4f_))(x4xi_, x4p_))

multi-index-monoid

multi-index-monoid(x) := [fun(x, nn), vnb-lambda([miu_, miv_], cartesian(fun(x, nn), fun(x, nn)), mi-add(x, miu_, miv_)), mi-zero(x)]

nag-metric-space

nag-metric-space(nag) := [carr(nag), vnb-lambda([u, v], cartesian(carr(nag), carr(nag)), (nrm(nag))((opr(nag))(u, (inv(nag))(v))))]

nbg-walk

nbg-walk(mnbp_) := {mnbz_ in expr-set: forall([mnbv_ in power(expr-set)], mnbp_ in mnbv_ implies nbg-closed(mnbv_) implies mnbz_ in mnbv_)}

neg-part

neg-part(omega, f) := vnb-lambda(npx_, omega, if(0 <= f(npx_), 0, -f(npx_)))

neg-variation

neg-variation(ca, nu) := pos-variation(ca, signed-neg(ca, nu))

nf-metric-space

nf-metric-space(nf) := [carr(nf), vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(carr(nf), carr(nf)), (fnrm(nf))((add(nf))(x, (neg(nf))(y))))]

nf-poly-over

nf-poly-over(ndsk_, ndsf_) := {ndsp_ in carr(poly(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(ndsk_))): forall([ndsi_ in nn], ndsp_(ndsi_) in ndsf_)}

nf-rat-at

nf-rat-at(ndsk_, ndsf_, ndsw_) := {ndsx_ in carr(ndsk_): forsome([ndsp_ in nf-poly-over(ndsk_, ndsf_), ndsq_ in nf-poly-over(ndsk_, ndsf_)], not(poly-eval(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(ndsk_), ndsq_, ndsw_) = zero(ndsk_)) and (mul(ndsk_))(ndsx_, poly-eval(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(ndsk_), ndsq_, ndsw_)) = poly-eval(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(ndsk_), ndsp_, ndsw_))}

nf-subfield-gen

nf-subfield-gen(bzk_, bzg_) := {bzz_ in carr(bzk_): forall([bzs_ in power(carr(bzk_))], is-nf-subfield(bzk_, bzs_) implies bzg_ subset bzs_ implies bzz_ in bzs_)}

nf-subfield-module

nf-subfield-module(fmk_, fms_) := [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(sub-nf(fmk_, fms_)), carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fmk_)), add(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fmk_)), zero(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fmk_)), neg(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fmk_)), vnb-lambda([fmr_, fmx_], cartesian(fms_, carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fmk_))), (mul(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fmk_)))(fmr_, fmx_))]

nn-enum

nn-enum(s) := choice({f in fun(nn, s): forall([m in nn, n in nn], m < n implies f(m) < f(n))})

nnfst

nnfst(n_) := iota(a_, a_ in nn and forsome([b_ in nn], nnpair(a_, b_) = n_))

nnpair

nnpair(i_, j_) := trinum(i_ + j_) + j_

nnsnd

nnsnd(n_) := iota(b_, b_ in nn and forsome([a_ in nn], nnpair(a_, b_) = n_))

node-content

node-content(ssp_, ssn_) := nth(2, nth(nth(1, ssn_), (strand-map(ssp_))(nth(2, ssn_))))

node-dir

node-dir(ssp_, ssn_) := nth(1, nth(nth(1, ssn_), (strand-map(ssp_))(nth(2, ssn_))))

nodes

nodes(ssp_) := {ssn_ in cartesian(nn, ids(ssp_)): 1 <= nth(1, ssn_) and nth(1, ssn_) <= length((strand-map(ssp_))(nth(2, ssn_)))}

norm-ball

norm-ball(c6vm_, c6vn_, c6vr_) := {c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_): c6vn_(c6vx_) <= c6vr_}

norm-optop

norm-optop(otv_) := seminorm-top(bh-module(otv_), pair(0, 0), norm-optop-pf(otv_))

norm-optop-pf

norm-optop-pf(otv_) := vnb-lambda(otk_, pair(0, 0), vnb-lambda(ott_, bounded-ops(otv_, otv_), opnorm(otv_, otv_, ott_)))

nv-ball

nv-ball(cwk_, cwa_, cwr_) := {cwx_ in cwa_: (fnrm(cwk_))(cwx_) <= cwr_}

nv-base

nv-base(bzk_, bzw_) := closure(nf-metric-space(bzk_), nf-subfield-gen(bzk_, nv-base-gen(bzk_, bzw_)))

nv-base-gen

nv-base-gen(bzk_, bzw_) := {bzz_ in carr(bzk_): bzz_ = bzw_ and forsome([bzp_], has-characteristic(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(bzk_), bzp_))}

nv-digit

nv-digit(dgk_, dgr_, dgz_) := iota(dgy_, dgy_ in dgr_ and (fnrm(dgk_))((add(dgk_))(dgz_, (neg(dgk_))(dgy_))) < 1)

nv-digits

nv-digits(ndsk_, ndsw_, ndsr_, ndsx_) := iota(ndsa_, ndsa_ in fun(zz, ndsr_) and forsome([ndsn_ in zz], is-nv-expansion(ndsk_, ndsw_, ndsr_, ndsa_, ndsn_, ndsx_)))

nv-ideal2

nv-ideal2(cwk_, cwa_, cwg_, cwh_) := {cwx_ in cwa_: forsome([cwm_ in cwa_, cwn_ in cwa_], cwx_ = (add(cwk_))((mul(cwk_))(cwm_, cwg_), (mul(cwk_))(cwn_, cwh_)))}

nv-integers

nv-integers(cwk_) := {cwx_ in carr(cwk_): (fnrm(cwk_))(cwx_) <= 1}

nv-maximal

nv-maximal(cwk_, cwa_) := {cwx_ in cwa_: (fnrm(cwk_))(cwx_) < 1}

nv-multiples

nv-multiples(cw3k_, cw3a_, cw3g_) := {cw3x_ in carr(cw3k_): forsome([cw3m_ in cw3a_], cw3x_ = (mul(cw3k_))(cw3m_, cw3g_))}

nv-principal

nv-principal(cwk_, cwa_, cwg_) := {cwx_ in cwa_: forsome([cwm_ in cwa_], cwx_ = (mul(cwk_))(cwm_, cwg_))}

nv-psum

nv-psum(ntk_, ntw_, nta_, ntn_, ntm_) := sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(ntk_), nv-term(ntk_, ntw_, nta_, ntn_), ntm_)

nv-res-ringoid

nv-res-ringoid(rsk_, rsa_) := [rsa_, vnb-lambda([rsu_, rsv_], cartesian(rsa_, rsa_), (add(rsk_))(rsu_, rsv_)), vnb-lambda([rsu_, rsv_], cartesian(rsa_, rsa_), (mul(rsk_))(rsu_, rsv_)), vnb-lambda(rsu_, rsa_, (neg(rsk_))(rsu_)), zero(rsk_), one(rsk_), nv-maximal(rsk_, rsa_)]

nv-residue

nv-residue(rsk_, rsa_) := ringoid-quotient-ring(nv-res-ringoid(rsk_, rsa_))

nv-term

nv-term(ntk_, ntw_, nta_, ntn_) := vnb-lambda(ntj_, nn, (mul(ntk_))(nta_(ntn_ + ntj_), nv-zpow(ntk_, ntw_, ntn_ + ntj_)))

nv-u1

nv-u1(c2k_, c2a_) := {c2x_ in c2a_: (fnrm(c2k_))((add(c2k_))(c2x_, (neg(c2k_))(one(c2k_)))) < 1}

nv-units

nv-units(cwk_, cwa_) := {cwx_ in cwa_: forsome([cwy_ in cwa_], (mul(cwk_))(cwx_, cwy_) = one(cwk_))}

nv-zf

nv-zf(bzk_, bzf_) := {bzz_ in nv-integers(bzk_): class(ringoid-setoid(nv-res-ringoid(bzk_, nv-integers(bzk_))), bzz_) in bzf_}

nv-zpow

nv-zpow(zpk_, zpw_, zpn_) := iota(zpy_, zpy_ in carr(zpk_) and (mul(zpk_))(zpy_, ring-power(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(zpk_), zpw_, max(-zpn_, 0))) = ring-power(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(zpk_), zpw_, max(zpn_, 0)))

nvs-metric-space

nvs-metric-space(m) := [vec(m), vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(vec(m), vec(m)), (vnrm(m))((vadd(m))(x, (vneg(m))(y))))]

ocint

ocint(a, b) := {osq_ in rr: a < osq_ and osq_ <= b}

onb-sets

onb-sets(kqv_) := {kqo_ in power(vec(kqv_)): is-orthonormal-basis(kqv_, kqo_, vnb-lambda(kqe_, kqo_, kqe_))}

ooint

ooint(a, b) := {icx_ in rr: a < icx_ and icx_ < b}

op-add

op-add(goa-md_, goa-t_) := vnb-lambda([goaf_, goag_], cartesian(ops(goa-md_, goa-t_), ops(goa-md_, goa-t_)), vnb-lambda(goaw_, vec(goa-md_), (vadd(goa-md_))(goaf_(goaw_), goag_(goaw_))))

op-adjoint

op-adjoint(bov_, bow_, bot_) := vnb-lambda(boy_, vec(bow_), iota(boz_, boz_ in vec(bov_) and forall([box_ in vec(bov_)], (ip(bow_))(bot_(box_), boy_) = (ip(bov_))(box_, boz_))))

op-alg

op-alg(gal-md_, gal-t_) := [ops(gal-md_, gal-t_), op-add(gal-md_, gal-t_), op-mul(gal-md_, gal-t_), op-neg(gal-md_, gal-t_), op-zero(gal-md_), op-one(gal-md_)]

op-dual

op-dual(otv_, otu_) := {otf_ in fun(bounded-ops(otv_, otv_), cc): is-linear-map(bh-module(otv_), cc-sn-module, otf_) and is-hom-top-space(otu_, cc-sn-top, otf_)}

op-kernel

op-kernel(bov_, bow_, bot_) := {box_ in vec(bov_): bot_(box_) = vzero(bow_)}

op-mat

op-mat(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_, x4t_) := iota(x4a_, x4a_ in mat(x4n_, x4n_, carr(scal(x4md_))) and map-seq(x4t_, x4n_, x4u_) = matact(x4md_, x4a_, x4u_))

op-mul

op-mul(gom-md_, gom-t_) := vnb-lambda([gomf_, gomg_], cartesian(ops(gom-md_, gom-t_), ops(gom-md_, gom-t_)), vnb-lambda(gomw_, vec(gom-md_), gomf_(gomg_(gomw_))))

op-neg

op-neg(gon-md_, gon-t_) := vnb-lambda(gonf_, ops(gon-md_, gon-t_), vnb-lambda(gonw_, vec(gon-md_), (vneg(gon-md_))(gonf_(gonw_))))

op-of

op-of(gof-md_, gof-t_, gof-p_) := vnb-lambda(gofw_, vec(gof-md_), poly-op(gof-md_, gof-t_, gof-p_, gofw_))

op-one

op-one(goo-md_) := vnb-lambda(goow_, vec(goo-md_), goow_)

op-range

op-range(bov_, bow_, bot_) := {boy_ in vec(bow_): forsome([box_ in vec(bov_)], boy_ = bot_(box_))}

op-sqrt

op-sqrt(kqv_, kqt_) := iota(kqs_, is-positive-op(kqv_, kqs_) and bop-comp(kqv_, kqs_, kqs_) = kqt_)

op-support

op-support(bov_, bow_, bot_) := perp(bov_, op-kernel(bov_, bow_, bot_))

op-trace

op-trace(kqv_, kqt_) := cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqe_, canon-onb(kqv_), (ip(kqv_))(kqt_(kqe_), kqe_)))

op-zero

op-zero(goz-md_) := vnb-lambda(gozw_, vec(goz-md_), vzero(goz-md_))

open-fun

open-fun(mxu_) := vnb-lambda([mxw_, mxj_], cartesian(expr-set, nn), expr-open(mxw_, mxj_, mxu_))

opg-ext

opg-ext(rpg_, rpa_, rpp_) := vnb-lambda(rvt_, rr, opg-val(rpg_, rpa_, rpp_, rvt_))

opg-val

opg-val(rpg_, rpa_, rpp_, rvt_) := iota(rvy_, rvy_ in carr(rpg_) and opg-rep(rpg_, rpa_, rpp_, rvt_, rvy_))

opnorm

opnorm(bov_, bow_, bot_) := sup({boa_ in rr: boa_ = 0 or forsome([box_ in vec(bov_)], not(ip-norm(bov_, box_) = 0) and boa_ = ip-norm(bow_, bot_(box_)) * recip(ip-norm(bov_, box_)))})

opp-group

opp-group(ogg_) := [carr(ogg_), vnb-lambda([ogp_, ogq_], cartesian(carr(ogg_), carr(ogg_)), (opr(ogg_))(ogq_, ogp_)), iden(ogg_), inv(ogg_)]

opp-metric-group

opp-metric-group(omg_) := make-metric-group(metric-group-ms(omg_), opp-group(metric-group-group(omg_)))

ops

ops(gos-md_, gos-t_) := {gosf_ in fun(vec(gos-md_), vec(gos-md_)): forsome([gosp_ in carr(poly(scal(gos-md_)))], gosf_ = op-of(gos-md_, gos-t_, gosp_))}

pad-ones

pad-ones(m, k, f) := vnb-lambda(poj_, interval(1, m), if(poj_ <= k, 1, f(nn-minus(poj_, k))))

padic-abs

padic-abs(cpp_) := vnb-lambda(cpx_, qq, iota(cpv_, cpv_ in rr and padic-rel(cpp_, cpx_, cpv_)))

padic-char

padic-char(cpp_) := vnb-lambda(cpx_, qq, iota(cpw_, cpw_ in cc and forsome([cpr_ in qq], padic-frac-rep(cpp_, cpx_, cpr_) and cpw_ = cc-exp(((2 * pi) * 1i) * cpr_))))

permutations

permutations(n) := injection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))

perp

perp(v, ks) := {prp_ in vec(v): forall([prk_ in ks], (ip(v))(prp_, prk_) = 0)}

phi-pm

phi-pm(mhm_, mhf_) := vnb-lambda(mhh_, power(pts(mhm_)), if(diam(mhm_, mhh_) = pos-inf, pos-inf, mhf_(diam(mhm_, mhh_))))

point-eval

point-eval(uet_, uex_) := vnb-lambda(uef_, ccont(uet_), uef_(uex_))

polar

polar(m, t, a) := {plf_ in top-dual(m, t): forall([plx_ in a], plf_(plx_) <= 1)}

pole-order

pole-order(pof_, poa_) := iota(pon_, is-pole(pof_, poa_, pon_))

poly

poly(a) := monalg(a, nn-add-monoid)

poly-eval

poly-eval(a, p, t) := sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(a), vnb-lambda(gek_, nn, (mul(a))(p(gek_), ring-power(a, t, gek_))), succ(deg(a, p)))

poly-fn-deg

poly-fn-deg(kk, a, f) := iota(pdgn_, pdgn_ in nn and is-poly-deg(kk, a, f, pdgn_))

poly-le

poly-le(a, m) := {gpl_ in carr(poly(a)): deg-bound(a, gpl_, m)}

poly-op

poly-op(gpo-md_, gpo-t_, gpo-p_, gpo-w_) := sum-ag(module-vector-ag(gpo-md_), vnb-lambda(gpok_, nn, (act(gpo-md_))(gpo-p_(gpok_), op-iter(gpo-md_, gpo-t_, gpo-w_, gpok_))), succ(deg(scal(gpo-md_), gpo-p_)))

pos-cone

pos-cone(pca_) := {pcx_ in vec(pca_): forall([pcc_ in power(vec(pca_))], forall([pcy_ in vec(pca_)], (vmul(pca_))((vstar(pca_))(pcy_), pcy_) in pcc_) implies forall([pcu_ in pcc_, pcv_ in pcc_], (vadd(pca_))(pcu_, pcv_) in pcc_) implies pcx_ in pcc_)}

pos-part

pos-part(omega, f) := vnb-lambda(ppx_, omega, if(0 <= f(ppx_), f(ppx_), 0))

pos-variation

pos-variation(ca, nu) := vnb-lambda(pva_, ca, esup({pvv_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([pve_ in ca], pve_ subset pva_ and nu(pve_) = pvv_)}))

powers-union

powers-union(pug_, puv_) := big-union(puk_, nn, set-power(pug_, puv_, puk_))

prec-strict

prec-strict(spc_, snd_, ssd_) := {ssp_ in cartesian(snd_, snd_): forall([ssq_ in power(cartesian(snd_, snd_))], is-prec-closed(spc_, snd_, ssd_, ssq_) implies ssp_ in ssq_)}

precedes

precedes(ssc_) := union(precedes-strict(ssc_), {ssp_ in cartesian(bnodes(ssc_), bnodes(ssc_)): nth(1, ssp_) = nth(2, ssp_)})

precedes-strict

precedes-strict(ssc_) := prec-strict(bspace(ssc_), bnodes(ssc_), bsend(ssc_))

pred

pred(n_) := iota(m_, m_ in nn and succ(m_) = n_)

prefix-dist

prefix-dist(ppa_, pdx_, pdy_) := if(pdx_ = pdy_, 0, recip(prefix-prod(ppa_, pdx_, agree-length(pdx_, pdy_))))

preimage

preimage(s, f, v) := {a in pts(s): f(a) in v}

primitive-roots

primitive-roots(prn_) := {prz_ in cc: prz_ ^ prn_ = 1 and forall([prm_ in nn], 1 <= prm_ implies prm_ < prn_ implies not(prz_ ^ prm_ = 1))}

principal-ideal

principal-ideal(s, a) := {x in carr(s): forsome([r in carr(s)], x = (mul(s))(r, a))}

prod-fun

prod-fun(pfu_, pff_) := vnb-lambda(pfx_, pfu_, prod-value(vnb-lambda(pfk_, nn, 1 + (pff_(pfk_))(pfx_))))

prod-ring

prod-ring(r, f, s) := finprod(commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm(r), f, s)

prod-rmod

prod-rmod(m) := [scal(m), cartesian(vec(m), rr), pv-vadd(m), [vzero(m), 0], pv-vneg(m), pv-act(m)]

prod-set

prod-set(cm, s, f) := finsum(cm, f, s)

prod-top

prod-top(t) := [cartesian(pts(t), rr), {ptu_ in power(cartesian(pts(t), rr)): is-pt-open(t, ptu_)}]

prod-value

prod-value(pvh_) := iota(pvl_, pvl_ in cc and prod-converges-to(pvh_, pvl_))

product-carrier

product-carrier(ms) := {x in fun(nn, big-union(n, nn, pts(ms(n)))): forall([n in nn], x(n) in pts(ms(n)))}

product-measure

product-measure(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu) := vnb-lambda(pmc_, product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb), integral(xs, ca, mu, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, pmc_)))

product-metric

product-metric(ms) := product-metric-w(ms, vnb-lambda(n, nn, (/)(1, 2 ^ (n + 1))))

product-metric-w

product-metric-w(ms, w) := [product-carrier(ms), vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(product-carrier(ms), product-carrier(ms)), iota(l, l in rr and series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n))), l)))]

product-proj

product-proj(ms, n) := vnb-lambda(x, product-carrier(ms), x(n))

product-sigma

product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb) := sigma-generated(cartesian(xs, ys), rectangles(xs, ca, ys, cb))

product2-ms

product2-ms(s, t) := [cartesian(pts(s), pts(t)), vnb-lambda([p2u_, p2v_], cartesian(cartesian(pts(s), pts(t)), cartesian(pts(s), pts(t))), max((dist(s))(nth(1, p2u_), nth(1, p2v_)), (dist(t))(nth(2, p2u_), nth(2, p2v_))))]

proj

proj(s) := vnb-lambda(a, pts(s), class(s, a))

proj-op

proj-op(bov_, bok_) := iota(bop_, is-orthogonal-projection(bov_, bok_, bop_))

pruefer

pruefer(prp_) := quotient-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(qp-field(prp_)), zp(prp_))

ps-partial-sum

ps-partial-sum(coef, x, k) := sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(n, nn, coef(n) * x ^ n), k)

pseudo-gauge-top

pseudo-gauge-top(fam, ground) := [ground, {u in power(ground): is-open-gauge(fam, ground, u)}]

pt-box

pt-box(t, v, c, e) := {ptz_ in cartesian(pts(t), rr): nth(1, ptz_) in v and abs(nth(2, ptz_) - c) < e}

pt-set-dist

pt-set-dist(m, x, es) := einf({mov_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([moz_ in es], mov_ = (dist(m))(x, moz_))})

pts-left-cosets

pts-left-cosets(lcs_, lcg_, lch_) := {lcu_ in power(pts(lcs_)): forsome([lcx_ in carr(lcg_)], lcu_ = {lcz_ in pts(lcs_): (opr(lcg_))((inv(lcg_))(lcx_), lcz_) in lch_})}

ptwise-eplus

ptwise-eplus(omega, f, g) := vnb-lambda(x_, omega, eplus(f(x_), g(x_)))

ptwise-epow

ptwise-epow(epo_, epf_, epp_) := vnb-lambda(epx_, epo_, epow(epf_(epx_), epp_))

ptwise-etimes

ptwise-etimes(omega, f, g) := vnb-lambda(x_, omega, etimes(f(x_), g(x_)))

ptwise-liminf

ptwise-liminf(omega, cf) := vnb-lambda(x_, omega, eliminf(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, (cf(n_))(x_))))

ptwise-net-limits

ptwise-net-limits(t, ee) := {pwf_ in fun(pts(t), rr): forsome([pwd_, pwp_], pwd_ in directed-set and is-directed-set(pwd_) and pwp_ in fun(pts(pwd_), ee) and forall([pwx_ in pts(t)], net-converges-to(metric-top(rr-ms), pwd_, vnb-lambda(pwl_, pts(pwd_), (pwp_(pwl_))(pwx_)), pwf_(pwx_))))}

ptwise-scale

ptwise-scale(omega, c, f) := vnb-lambda(x_, omega, etimes(c, f(x_)))

ptwise-sup

ptwise-sup(omega, cf) := vnb-lambda(x_, omega, esup(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, (cf(n_))(x_)), nn)))

pullback-measure

pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu) := vnb-lambda(mpm_, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), nu(image(f, mpm_)))

pullback-ms

pullback-ms(mt, ss, jj) := [ss, vnb-lambda([pbu_, pbv_], cartesian(ss, ss), (dist(mt))(jj(pbu_), jj(pbv_)))]

pullback-sigma

pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f) := {mpa_ in power(omega): forsome([mpb_ in cb], mpa_ = {mpx_ in omega: f(mpx_) in mpb_})}

push-forward

push-forward(omega, cb, mu, h) := vnb-lambda(pwb_, cb, mu({pwx_ in omega: h(pwx_) in pwb_}))

pv-act

pv-act(m) := vnb-lambda([pvr_, pvc_], cartesian(carr(scal(m)), cartesian(vec(m), rr)), [(act(m))(pvr_, nth(1, pvc_)), pvr_ * nth(2, pvc_)])

pv-vadd

pv-vadd(m) := vnb-lambda([pva_, pvb_], cartesian(cartesian(vec(m), rr), cartesian(vec(m), rr)), [(vadd(m))(nth(1, pva_), nth(1, pvb_)), nth(2, pva_) + nth(2, pvb_)])

pv-vneg

pv-vneg(m) := vnb-lambda(pvc_, cartesian(vec(m), rr), [(vneg(m))(nth(1, pvc_)), -nth(2, pvc_)])

pw-int

pw-int(pphi_, a, b) := iota(pav_, pav_ in rr and forsome([paw_], is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b) and pav_ = paw_(b) - paw_(a)))

qmod-act

zz-act

zz-act(g_, k_, a_) := if(k_ in nn, mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g_), a_, k_), (inv(g_))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g_), a_, -k_)))

zz-bezout-set

zz-bezout-set(a, b) := {z in zz: forsome([x_ in zz, y_ in zz], z = x_ * a + y_ * b)}

zz-mod

zz-mod(a) := quotient-module(ring-as-module(zz-ring), principal-ideal(zz-ring, a))

zz-pow

zz-pow(n) := direct-sum(zz-ring, n, vnb-lambda(zpi_, interval(1, n), ring-as-module(zz-ring)))

zz-residue

zz-residue(k, m) := choice({zrr_ in interval(1, m): zz-divides(m, k - zrr_)})

zz-row

zz-row(n, x) := matof(1, n, vnb-lambda([zra_, zrb_], cartesian(interval(1, 1), interval(1, n)), x(zrb_)))

zz-units

zz-units(n) := matof(n, 1, vnb-lambda([zua_, zub_], cartesian(interval(1, n), interval(1, 1)), vnb-lambda(zut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, zua_), 1, zut_))))

forall([omega, mu, es_], es_ in caratheodory-sets(omega, mu) iff es_ in power(omega) and is-caratheodory-measurable(omega, mu, es_))

cc-coords-def

cc-coords == vnb-lambda(zv_, cc, [real-part(zv_), imag-part(zv_)])

cc-hat-def

cc-hat == union(cc, singleton(cc-inf))

cc-hat-opens-def

cc-hat-opens == {uh_ in power(cc-hat): uh_ subset cc and is-open(cc-ms, uh_) or forsome([kh_ in power(cc)], kh_ subset cc and is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kh_)) and uh_ = difference(cc-hat, kh_))}

cc-matrices == {cmq_ in mat(2, 2, rr): forsome([cma_ in rr, cmb_ in rr], cmq_ = cc-matrix-of(cma_, cmb_))}

cc-matrix-rep-def

cc-matrix-rep == vnb-lambda(cmz_, cc, cc-matrix-of(real-part(cmz_), imag-part(cmz_)))

cc-ms-def

cc-ms = [cc, vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(cc, cc), magnitude(x - y))]

cc-ms@dist

dist(cc-ms) == vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(cc, cc), magnitude(x - y))

cc-ms@pts

pts(cc-ms) == cc

cc-nag-def

cc-nag = [cc, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_), 0, vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_), vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))]

cc-nag@carr

carr(cc-nag) == cc

cc-nag@iden

iden(cc-nag) == 0

cc-nag@inv

inv(cc-nag) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_)

cc-nag@nrm

nrm(cc-nag) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))

cc-nag@opr

opr(cc-nag) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_)

cc-normed-field-def

cc-normed-field = [cc, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_), 0, 1, vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))]

cc-normed-field@add

add(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_)

cc-normed-field@carr

carr(cc-normed-field) == cc

cc-normed-field@fnrm

fnrm(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))

cc-normed-field@mul

mul(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ * y_)

cc-normed-field@neg

neg(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_)

cc-normed-field@one

one(cc-normed-field) == 1

cc-normed-field@zero

zero(cc-normed-field) == 0

cc-of-pair-def

cc-of-pair == vnb-lambda(pv_, cartesian(rr, rr), nth(1, pv_) + nth(2, pv_) * 1i)

cc-partial-prod-succ

forall([cpf_, cpn_ in nn], cc-partial-prod(cpf_, succ(cpn_)) == cc-partial-prod(cpf_, cpn_) * cpf_(cpn_))

cc-partial-prod-zero

forall([cpf_], cc-partial-prod(cpf_, 0) == 1)

cc-sn-module-def

cc-sn-module == ring-as-module(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field))

cc-sn-pf-def

cc-sn-pf == vnb-lambda(otk_, pair(0, 0), vnb-lambda(otz_, cc, magnitude(otz_)))

cc-sn-top-def

cc-sn-top == seminorm-top(cc-sn-module, pair(0, 0), cc-sn-pf)

cc2-sphere-def

cc2-sphere == {hsw_ in cartesian(cc, cc): magnitude(nth(1, hsw_)) * magnitude(nth(1, hsw_)) + magnitude(nth(2, hsw_)) * magnitude(nth(2, hsw_)) = 1}

cchs-succ

forall([m57x_, m57a_, m57n_, m57l_, m57k_ in nn], cchs(m57x_, m57a_, m57n_, m57l_, succ(m57k_)) == enc-ex(enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), nth(m57n_ - m57k_, m57a_)), cchs(m57x_, m57a_, m57n_, m57l_, m57k_))))

cchs-zero

forall([m57x_, m57a_, m57n_, m57l_], cchs(m57x_, m57a_, m57n_, m57l_, 0) == enc-eq(m57x_, enc-list(m57l_)))

cips-ip-add-left

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v), z_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((vadd(v))(x_, y_), z_) = (ip(v))(x_, z_) + (ip(v))(y_, z_)))

cips-ip-conj-sym

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(y_, x_) = conjugate((ip(v))(x_, y_))))

cips-ip-definite

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) = 0 iff x_ = vzero(v)))

cips-ip-homog-left

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((act(v))(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * (ip(v))(x_, y_)))

cips-ip-zero-vector

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(v)))

cips-scal-carrier

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies carr(scal(v)) = cc)

cips-vadd-vzero

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (vadd(v))(vzero(v), x_) = x_))

clf-def

clf == {mce_ in expr-set: wf-fml(mce_) and expr-lc(mce_)}

closed-intervals-def

closed-intervals == {oci_ in power(rr): oci_ = empty-set or forsome([oca_ in rr, ocb_ in rr], oca_ <= ocb_ and oci_ = ccint(oca_, ocb_))}

clt-def

clt == {mce_ in expr-set: wf-term(mce_) and expr-lc(mce_)}

ell-one-def

ell-one = {x_ in sqn(cc): series-converges(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, magnitude(x_(k_))))}

ell-two-def

ell-two = {x_ in sqn(cc): series-converges(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, magnitude(x_(k_)) * magnitude(x_(k_))))}

enc-ande-succ

forall([mcl_, mca_, mcn_ in nn], enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, mcn_), enc-in(nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_), mca_)))

enc-ande-zero

forall([mcl_, mca_], enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, 0) == enc-truth)

enc-andl-succ

forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(mcx_, nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))

enc-andl-zero

forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-truth)

enc-cartl-succ

forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(enc-nth(enc-num(succ(mcn_)), mcx_), nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))

enc-cartl-zero

forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-truth)

enc-cch-succ

forall([mix_, mia_, min_, mik_ in nn], enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, succ(mik_)) == enc-ex(enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), nth(min_ - mik_, mia_)), enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, mik_))))

enc-cch-zero

forall([mix_, mia_, min_], enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, 0) == enc-eq(mix_, enc-list(idx-list(min_))))

enc-eql-succ

forall([mcl_, mca_, mcn_ in nn], enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, mcn_), enc-eq(nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_), nth(succ(mcn_), mca_))))

enc-eql-zero

forall([mcl_, mca_], enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, 0) == enc-truth)

enc-falsity-def

enc-falsity == eapp(1, [])

enc-nnc-def

enc-nnc == econst(3)

enc-ordc-def

enc-ordc == econst(5)

enc-orl-succ

forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-or(enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(mcx_, nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))

enc-orl-zero

forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-falsity)

enc-setc-def

enc-setc == econst(1)

enc-truth-def

enc-truth == eapp(0, [])

eplus-def

eplus == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr-pos-star, rr-pos-star), if(x_ = pos-inf or y_ = pos-inf, pos-inf, binplus(x_, y_)))

etimes-def

etimes == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr-pos-star, rr-pos-star), if(x_ = pos-inf or y_ = pos-inf, if(x_ = 0 or y_ = 0, 0, pos-inf), bintimes(x_, y_)))

euler-gamma-def

euler-gamma == 1 - series-limit(vnb-lambda(egk_, nn, log(succ(succ(egk_))) - log(succ(egk_)) - recip(succ(succ(egk_)))))

even-def

forall([x], even(x) iff forsome([k in zz], x = 2 * k))

expr-set-def

expr-set == big-union(mxn_, nn, expr-stage(mxn_))

expr-stage-succ

forall([mxn_ in nn], expr-stage(succ(mxn_)) == union(expr-stage(mxn_), union(cartesian(pair(3, 3), nn, tuples(expr-stage(mxn_))), cartesian(pair(4, 4), nn, nn, tuples(expr-stage(mxn_)), expr-stage(mxn_)))))

expr-stage-zero

expr-stage(0) == union(cartesian(pair(0, 0), nn), union(cartesian(pair(1, 1), nn), cartesian(pair(2, 2), nn)))

factorial-succ

forall([k in nn], factorial(succ(k)) = succ(k) * factorial(k))

factorial-zero

factorial(0) = succ(0)

falling-succ

forall([n, k in nn], falling(n, succ(k)) == (n - k) * falling(n, k))

falling-zero

forall([n], falling(n, 0) == succ(0))

fam-of-list-apply

forall([l, i], i in nn and succ(i) <= length(l) implies (fam-of-list(l))(i) = nth(succ(i), l))

hopf-quotient-map-def

hopf-quotient-map == vnb-lambda(hqp_, unit-sphere-cr, homog-point(nth(1, hqp_), 1 - nth(2, hqp_)))

ideal-stage-succ

forall([sbrt_, sbrk_, sbrks_, sbrs_, sbrn_ in nn], ideal-stage(sbrt_, sbrk_, sbrks_, sbrs_, succ(sbrn_)) == {sbrm_ in msg-set(sbrt_, sbrk_): forsome([sbrg_ in key-ideal-gen(sbrt_, sbrk_, empty-set, ideal-stage(sbrt_, sbrk_, sbrks_, sbrs_, sbrn_)), sbry_ in sbrks_], sbrm_ = encr(sbrg_, sbry_))})

ideal-stage-zero

forall([sbrt_, sbrk_, sbrks_, sbrs_], ideal-stage(sbrt_, sbrk_, sbrks_, sbrs_, 0) == sbrs_)

imag-part-def

forall([z], imag-part(z) == (z - conjugate(z)) * recip(2 * 1i))

image-membership-iff

forall([phi, s, w], w in image(phi, s) iff w in set and forsome([x in s], phi(x) = w))

inf-subsets-membership

forall([a, s], s in inf-subsets(a) iff s subset a and not(card(s) in nn))

injection-membership-iff

forall([x, y, phi], phi in injection(x, y) iff phi in fun(x, y) and forall([a in x, b in x], phi(a) = phi(b) implies a = b))

ip-normed-ag-carrier

forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies carr(ip-normed-ag(v)) == vec(v))

ip-normed-ag-norm-value

forall([v, x in vec(v)], (nrm(ip-normed-ag(v)))(x) == ip-norm(v, x))

is-bounded-linear-arrow-def

forall([a, b, f], is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forsome([blk_ in rr], 0 <= blk_ and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(b))(f(x1_)) <= blk_ * (vnrm(a))(x1_))))

is-c-continuous-arrow-def

forall([a, b, f], is-c-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-continuous(c-metric(a), c-metric(b), f))

is-continuous-arrow-def

forall([a, b, f], is-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-continuous(a, b, f))

is-hom-abelian-group-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-abelian-group(a, b, f) iff is-abelian-group(a) and is-abelian-group(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))))

is-hom-bundle-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-bundle(a, b, f) iff is-bundle(a) and is-bundle(b) and f in fun(bnodes(a), bnodes(b)) and bspace(a) = bspace(b) and forall([x1_ in bnodes(a), x2_ in bnodes(a)], [x1_, x2_] in bsend(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in bsend(b)))

is-hom-c-metric-space-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-c-metric-space(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in nn], (dists(a))(x1_) = (dists(b))(x1_)))

is-hom-comm-monoid-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-comm-monoid(a, b, f) iff is-comm-monoid(a) and is-comm-monoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b))

is-hom-commutative-banach-algebra-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-commutative-banach-algebra(a, b, f) iff is-commutative-banach-algebra(a) and is-commutative-banach-algebra(b) and is-hom-unital-banach-algebra(a, b, f))

is-hom-commutative-c-star-algebra-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-commutative-c-star-algebra(a, b, f) iff is-commutative-c-star-algebra(a) and is-commutative-c-star-algebra(b) and is-hom-unital-c-star-algebra(a, b, f))

is-hom-commutative-ring-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-commutative-ring(a, b, f) iff is-commutative-ring(a) and is-commutative-ring(b) and is-hom-ring(a, b, f))

is-hom-complex-banach-algebra-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-complex-banach-algebra(a, b, f) iff is-complex-banach-algebra(a) and is-complex-banach-algebra(b) and is-hom-complex-normed-algebra(a, b, f))

is-hom-complex-banach-space-def

forall([a, b, f], is-hom-complex-banach-space(a, b, f) iff is-complex-banach-space(a) and is-complex-banach-space(b) and is-hom-complex-normed-vector-space(a, b, f))

is-hom-complex-inner-product-space-def

lcd-stage-succ

forall([mxn_ in nn], lcd-stage(succ(mxn_)) == vnb-lambda(mxe_, expr-stage(succ(mxn_)), if(mxe_ in expr-stage(mxn_), (lcd-stage(mxn_))(mxe_), if(nth(1, mxe_) = 3, {mxd_ in nn: forall([mxw_ in make-set(nth(3, mxe_))], mxd_ in (lcd-stage(mxn_))(mxw_))}, {mxd_ in nn: forall([mxw_ in make-set(nth(4, mxe_))], mxd_ in (lcd-stage(mxn_))(mxw_)) and mxd_ + nth(3, mxe_) in (lcd-stage(mxn_))(nth(5, mxe_))}))))

lcd-stage-zero

lcd-stage(0) == vnb-lambda(mxe_, expr-stage(0), if(nth(1, mxe_) = 1, {mxd_ in nn: nth(2, mxe_) < mxd_}, nn))

length-cons

forall([x, l], x in set implies length(cons(x, l)) = succ(length(l)))

lft-group-def

lft-group = [lfts, vnb-lambda([lfg_, lfh_], cartesian(lfts, lfts), compose(lfg_, lfh_)), id-fun(cc-hat), vnb-lambda(lfg_, lfts, inverse-bij(lfg_, cc-hat, cc-hat))]

lft-group@carr

carr(lft-group) == lfts

lft-group@iden

iden(lft-group) == id-fun(cc-hat)

lft-group@inv

inv(lft-group) == vnb-lambda(lfg_, lfts, inverse-bij(lfg_, cc-hat, cc-hat))

lft-group@opr

opr(lft-group) == vnb-lambda([lfg_, lfh_], cartesian(lfts, lfts), compose(lfg_, lfh_))

lfts-def

lfts == {lff_ in fun(cc-hat, cc-hat): forsome([lfa_ in cc, lfb_ in cc, lfc_ in cc, lfd_ in cc], not(lfa_ * lfd_ - lfb_ * lfc_ = 0) and lff_ = lft(lfa_, lfb_, lfc_, lfd_))}

limit-ord-iff

forall([lambda], limit-ord(lambda) iff lambda in ord and not(lambda = 0) and not(forsome([alpha in ord], lambda = succ_ord(alpha))))

nary-minus-2

forall([x, y], x - y == binplus(x, binneg(y)))

nary-neg-1

forall([x], -x == binneg(x))

nary-plus-2

forall([x, y], x + y == binplus(x, y))

nary-plus-3

forall([x, y, z], x + y + z == binplus(binplus(x, y), z))

nary-plus-4

forall([w, x, y, z], w + x + y + z == binplus(binplus(binplus(w, x), y), z))

nary-plus-5

forall([v, w, x, y, z], v + w + x + y + z == binplus(binplus(binplus(binplus(v, w), x), y), z))

nary-times-2

forall([x, y], x * y == bintimes(x, y))

nary-times-3

forall([x, y, z], x * y * z == bintimes(bintimes(x, y), z))

nary-times-4

forall([w, x, y, z], w * x * y * z == bintimes(bintimes(bintimes(w, x), y), z))

nary-times-5

forall([v, w, x, y, z], v * w * x * y * z == bintimes(bintimes(bintimes(bintimes(v, w), x), y), z))

neumann-sum-succ

forall([bna_, bnx_, bnk_ in nn], neumann-sum(bna_, bnx_, succ(bnk_)) == (vadd(bna_))(neumann-sum(bna_, bnx_, bnk_), el-pow(bna_, bnx_, bnk_)))

neumann-sum-zero

forall([bna_, bnx_], neumann-sum(bna_, bnx_, 0) == vzero(bna_))

nf-metric-carrier

forall([nf], pts(nf-metric-space(nf)) == carr(nf))

nf-metric-distance

forall([nf], is-normed-field(nf) implies forall([x in carr(nf), y in carr(nf)], (dist(nf-metric-space(nf)))(x, y) = (fnrm(nf))((add(nf))(x, (neg(nf))(y)))))

nn-add-monoid-def

nn-add-monoid = [nn, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(nn, nn), x_ + y_), 0]

nn-add-monoid@carr

carr(nn-add-monoid) == nn

nn-add-monoid@iden

iden(nn-add-monoid) == 0

nn-add-monoid@opr

opr(nn-add-monoid) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(nn, nn), x_ + y_)

nn-add-succ

forall([a in nn, b in nn], a + succ(b) = succ(a + b))

nn-directed-def

nn-directed = [nn, {ndp_ in cartesian(nn, nn): nth(1, ndp_) <= nth(2, ndp_)}]

nn-minus-def

forall([k in nn, l in nn], nn-minus(k, l) = if(l <= k, k - l, 0))

nnreal-def

nnreal == {mhr_ in rr: 0 <= mhr_}

nstar-def

nstar == big-union(nsk_, nn, fun(ord-segment(nsk_), nn))

nth-cons-1

forall([x, l], x in set implies nth(1, cons(x, l)) = x)

nth-cons-succ

forall([i, x, l], x in set implies i in nn and 1 <= i and i <= length(l) implies nth(succ(i), cons(x, l)) = nth(i, l))

nth-deriv-on-succ

forall([ndvk_, ndvu_, ndvf_, ndvn_ in nn], nth-deriv-on(ndvk_, ndvu_, ndvf_, succ(ndvn_)) == vnb-lambda(ndvz_, ndvu_, deriv-on(ndvk_, ndvu_, nth-deriv-on(ndvk_, ndvu_, ndvf_, ndvn_), ndvz_)))

nth-deriv-on-zero

forall([ndvk_, ndvu_, ndvf_], nth-deriv-on(ndvk_, ndvu_, ndvf_, 0) == ndvf_)

nth-deriv-succ

forall([f, n in nn], nth-deriv(f, succ(n)) == vnb-lambda(x, rr, deriv(nth-deriv(f, n), x)))

nth-deriv-v-succ

forall([m, f, n in nn], nth-deriv-v(m, f, succ(n)) == vnb-lambda(x, rr, deriv-v(m, nth-deriv-v(m, f, n), x)))

nth-deriv-v-zero

forall([m, f], nth-deriv-v(m, f, 0) == f)

nth-deriv-zero

forall([f], nth-deriv(f, 0) == f)

forall([x], odd(x) iff forsome([k in zz], x = 2 * k + 1))

forall([goi-md_, goi-t_, goi-w_, m in nn], op-iter(goi-md_, goi-t_, goi-w_, succ(m)) == goi-t_(op-iter(goi-md_, goi-t_, goi-w_, m)))

forall([mxu_, mxn_ in nn], open-stage(mxu_, succ(mxn_)) == vnb-lambda([mxe_, mxk_], cartesian(expr-stage(succ(mxn_)), nn), if(mxe_ in expr-stage(mxn_), (open-stage(mxu_, mxn_))(mxe_, mxk_), if(nth(1, mxe_) = 3, [3, nth(2, mxe_), maplk(open-stage(mxu_, mxn_), nth(3, mxe_), mxk_)], [4, nth(2, mxe_), nth(3, mxe_), maplk(open-stage(mxu_, mxn_), nth(4, mxe_), mxk_), (open-stage(mxu_, mxn_))(nth(5, mxe_), mxk_ + nth(3, mxe_))]))))

open-stage-zero

forall([mcob_, mcol_, mcon_ in nn], openl(mcob_, mcol_, succ(mcon_)) == expr-open(openl(mcob_, mcol_, mcon_), mcon_, nth(succ(mcon_), mcol_)))

forall([mcob_, mcol_], openl(mcob_, mcol_, 0) == mcob_)

ord-lt-iff

forall([alpha, beta], ord-lt(alpha, beta) iff ord-le(alpha, beta) and not(alpha = beta))

pi-def

pi == iota(cekp_, cekp_ in rr and 0 < cekp_ and forall([cekz_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 iff forsome([cekk_ in zz], cekz_ = cekk_ * ((2 * cekp_) * 1i))))

forall([pcz_, pcn_ in nn], poch(pcz_, succ(pcn_)) == poch(pcz_, pcn_) * (pcz_ + pcn_))

qq-field-def

qq-field = [qq, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_), 0, 1, difference(qq, singleton(0)), vnb-lambda(x_, difference(qq, singleton(0)), recip(x_))]

qq-field@add

add(qq-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_)

qq-field@carr

carr(qq-field) == qq

qq-field@mul

mul(qq-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_)

qq-field@mul-inv

mul-inv(qq-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, difference(qq, singleton(0)), recip(x_))

qq-field@neg

neg(qq-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_)

qq-field@non-zero

non-zero(qq-field) == difference(qq, singleton(0))

qq-field@one

one(qq-field) == 1

qq-field@zero

zero(qq-field) == 0

qq-line-def

qq-line = [field-as-integral-domain(qq-field), qq, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_), 0, vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_), vnb-lambda([r_, x_], cartesian(qq, qq), r_ * x_)]

qq-line@act

act(qq-line) == vnb-lambda([r_, x_], cartesian(qq, qq), r_ * x_)

qq-line@scal

scal(qq-line) == field-as-integral-domain(qq-field)

qq-line@vadd

vadd(qq-line) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_)

qq-line@vec

vec(qq-line) == qq

qq-line@vneg

vneg(qq-line) == vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_)

qq-line@vzero

vzero(qq-line) == 0

qq-ring-def

qq-ring = [qq, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_), 0, 1]

qq-ring@add

add(qq-ring) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_)

qq-ring@carr

carr(qq-ring) == qq

qq-ring@mul

mul(qq-ring) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_)

qq-ring@neg

neg(qq-ring) == vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_)

qq-ring@one

one(qq-ring) == 1

qq-ring@zero

zero(qq-ring) == 0

quotient-card-norm-cna-as-module

real-part-def

forall([z], real-part(z) == (z + conjugate(z)) * recip(2))

received-def

received = 1

recip-gamma-def

recip-gamma == vnb-lambda(egz_, cc, (egz_ * cc-exp(euler-gamma * egz_)) * (prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, -succ(c6gk_)))(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, -succ(c6gk_)))(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, 1))(c6k_)))) - 1))))(egz_))

reduce-one

forall([op, f], reduce(op, f, 1) == f(0))

reduce-succ

forall([op, f, n], n in nn and 1 <= n implies reduce(op, f, succ(n)) == op(reduce(op, f, n), f(n)))

rpow-def

forall([a_, b_], rpow(a_, b_) == rpow-star(a_, b_))

rq-add

forall([r], add(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == descend2(ringoid-setoid(r), vnb-lambda([a, b], cartesian(carr(r), carr(r)), class(ringoid-setoid(r), (add(r))(a, b)))))

rq-carr

forall([r], carr(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == quotient(ringoid-setoid(r)))

rq-mul

forall([r], mul(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == descend2(ringoid-setoid(r), vnb-lambda([a, b], cartesian(carr(r), carr(r)), class(ringoid-setoid(r), (mul(r))(a, b)))))

rq-neg

forall([r], neg(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == descend(ringoid-setoid(r), vnb-lambda(a, carr(r), class(ringoid-setoid(r), (neg(r))(a)))))

rq-one

forall([r], one(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == class(ringoid-setoid(r), one(r)))

rq-zero

forall([r], zero(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == class(ringoid-setoid(r), zero(r)))

rr-abs-def

forall([x in rr], (0 <= x implies abs(x) = x) and (not(0 <= x) implies abs(x) = -x))

rr-bounded-ms-def

rr-bounded-ms == bdd-metric(rr-ms)

rr-ext-down-def

rr-ext-down == union(rr, singleton(neg-inf))

rr-ext-up-def

rr-ext-up == union(rr, singleton(pos-inf))

rr-field-def

rr-field = [rr, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_), 0, 1, difference(rr, singleton(0)), vnb-lambda(x_, difference(rr, singleton(0)), recip(x_))]

rr-field@add

add(rr-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_)

rr-field@carr

carr(rr-field) == rr

rr-field@mul

mul(rr-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ * y_)

rr-field@mul-inv

mul-inv(rr-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, difference(rr, singleton(0)), recip(x_))

rr-field@neg

neg(rr-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_)

rr-field@non-zero

non-zero(rr-field) == difference(rr, singleton(0))

rr-field@one

one(rr-field) == 1

rr-field@zero

zero(rr-field) == 0

rr-max-def

forall([x in rr, y in rr], (y <= x implies max(x, y) = x) and (not(y <= x) implies max(x, y) = y))

rr-min-def

forall([x in rr, y in rr], (x <= y implies min(x, y) = x) and (not(x <= y) implies min(x, y) = y))

rr-ms-def

rr-ms = [rr, vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(rr, rr), abs(x - y))]

rr-ms@dist

dist(rr-ms) == vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(rr, rr), abs(x - y))

rr-ms@pts

pts(rr-ms) == rr

rr-normed-field-def

rr-normed-field = [rr, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_), 0, 1, vnb-lambda(x_, rr, abs(x_))]

rr-normed-field@add

add(rr-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_)

rr-normed-field@carr

carr(rr-normed-field) == rr

rr-normed-field@fnrm

fnrm(rr-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, rr, abs(x_))

rr-normed-field@mul

mul(rr-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ * y_)

rr-normed-field@neg

neg(rr-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_)

rr-normed-field@one

one(rr-normed-field) == 1

rr-normed-field@zero

zero(rr-normed-field) == 0

rr-nvs-def

rr-nvs = [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field), rr, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_), 0, vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_), vnb-lambda([r_, x_], cartesian(rr, rr), r_ * x_), vnb-lambda(x_, rr, abs(x_))]

rr-nvs@act

act(rr-nvs) == vnb-lambda([r_, x_], cartesian(rr, rr), r_ * x_)

rr-nvs@scal

scal(rr-nvs) == normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field)

rr-nvs@vadd

vadd(rr-nvs) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_)

rr-nvs@vec

vec(rr-nvs) == rr

rr-nvs@vneg

vneg(rr-nvs) == vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_)

rr-nvs@vnrm

vnrm(rr-nvs) == vnb-lambda(x_, rr, abs(x_))

rr-nvs@vzero

vzero(rr-nvs) == 0

rr-pos-star-add-monoid-def

rr-pos-star-add-monoid = [rr-pos-star, eplus, 0]

rr-pos-star-add-monoid@carr

carr(rr-pos-star-add-monoid) == rr-pos-star

rr-pos-star-add-monoid@iden

iden(rr-pos-star-add-monoid) == 0

rr-pos-star-add-monoid@opr

opr(rr-pos-star-add-monoid) == eplus

rr-pos-star-membership

forall([x], x in rr-pos-star iff x in rr and 0 <= x or x = pos-inf)

rr-star-membership

forall([x], x in rr-star iff x in rr or x = pos-inf or x = neg-inf)

rw-univ-def

rw-univ == cartesian(nn, ctx-set, expr-set, expr-set)

sent-def

sent = 0

seq-def

seq-set == cartesian(ctx-set, clf)

set-power-succ

forall([sqg_, sqv_, sqk_ in nn], set-power(sqg_, sqv_, succ(sqk_)) == set-prod(sqg_, set-power(sqg_, sqv_, sqk_), sqv_))

set-power-zero

forall([sqg_, sqv_], set-power(sqg_, sqv_, 0) == singleton(iden(sqg_)))

sigma-generated-membership

forall([omega, ce, a_], a_ in sigma-generated(omega, ce) iff a_ in power(omega) and forall([cb_], cb_ in power(power(omega)) and is-sigma-algebra(omega, cb_) and ce subset cb_ implies a_ in cb_))

sip-act-neg-scalar-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([q_ in rr, x_ in vec(r)], (act(r))(-q_, x_) = (vneg(r))((act(r))(q_, x_))))

sip-act-neg-scalar-rev-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([q_ in rr, x_ in vec(r)], (vneg(r))((act(r))(q_, x_)) = (act(r))(-q_, x_)))

sip-class-eq-iff-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([a_ in vec(r), b_ in vec(r)], class(sip-setoid(csip-as-sip(r)), a_) = class(sip-setoid(csip-as-sip(r)), b_) iff (rip(r))((vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_)), (vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_))) = 0))

sip-class-eq-iff-rev-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([a_ in vec(r), b_ in vec(r)], (rip(r))((vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_)), (vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_))) = 0 iff class(sip-setoid(csip-as-sip(r)), a_) = class(sip-setoid(csip-as-sip(r)), b_)))

sip-expand-two-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([x_ in vec(r), y_ in vec(r), a_ in rr, b_ in rr], (rip(r))((vadd(r))((act(r))(a_, x_), (act(r))(b_, y_)), (vadd(r))((act(r))(a_, x_), (act(r))(b_, y_))) = ((a_ * a_) * (rip(r))(x_, x_) + (2 * (a_ * b_)) * (rip(r))(x_, y_)) + (b_ * b_) * (rip(r))(y_, y_)))

sip-expand-two-rev-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([x_ in vec(r), y_ in vec(r), a_ in rr, b_ in rr], ((a_ * a_) * (rip(r))(x_, x_) + (2 * (a_ * b_)) * (rip(r))(x_, y_)) + (b_ * b_) * (rip(r))(y_, y_) = (rip(r))((vadd(r))((act(r))(a_, x_), (act(r))(b_, y_)), (vadd(r))((act(r))(a_, x_), (act(r))(b_, y_)))))

sip-null-act-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([a_ in rr, x_ in vec(r)], (rip(r))(x_, x_) = 0 implies (rip(r))((act(r))(a_, x_), (act(r))(a_, x_)) = 0))

sip-null-act-rev-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([a_ in rr, x_ in vec(r)], (rip(r))(x_, x_) = 0 implies 0 = (rip(r))((act(r))(a_, x_), (act(r))(a_, x_))))

sip-null-orth-csip-as-sip

sip-null-orth-rev-csip-as-sip

sip-null-out-csip-as-sip

sip-null-vadd-rev-csip-as-sip

sip-null-vneg-csip-as-sip

sip-null-vneg-rev-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([x_ in vec(r)], (rip(r))(x_, x_) = 0 implies 0 = (rip(r))((vneg(r))(x_), (vneg(r))(x_))))

sip-rel-out-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([a_, b_], [a_, b_] in sip-rel(csip-as-sip(r)) implies (rip(r))((vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_)), (vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_))) = 0))

sip-rel-out-rev-csip-as-sip

sip-related-out-csip-as-sip

sip-related-out-rev-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([a_, b_], related(sip-setoid(csip-as-sip(r)), a_, b_) implies 0 = (rip(r))((vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_)), (vadd(r))(a_, (vneg(r))(b_)))))

sip-rip-add-left-csip-as-sip

forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([x_ in vec(r), y_ in vec(r), z_ in vec(r)], (rip(r))((vadd(r))(x_, y_), z_) = (rip(r))(x_, z_) + (rip(r))(y_, z_)))

sip-rip-add-left-rev-csip-as-sip

sip-rip-add-right-csip-as-sip

sip-rip-add-right-rev-csip-as-sip

sip-rip-homog-left-csip-as-sip

sip-rip-homog-left-rev-csip-as-sip

sip-rip-homog-right-csip-as-sip

sip-rip-neg-left-rev-csip-as-sip

triv-group-def

triv-group = [pair(0, 0), vnb-lambda([tgp_, tgq_], cartesian(pair(0, 0), pair(0, 0)), 0), 0, vnb-lambda(tgp_, pair(0, 0), 0)]

unit-circle-def

unit-circle == {ucz_ in cc: magnitude(ucz_) = 1}

unit-sphere-cr-def

unit-sphere-cr == {hsp_ in cartesian(cc, rr): magnitude(nth(1, hsp_)) * magnitude(nth(1, hsp_)) + nth(2, hsp_) * nth(2, hsp_) = 1}

upper-half-plane-def

upper-half-plane == {hpz_ in cc: 0 < imag-part(hpz_)}

ury-apx-succ

forall([uat_, uax_, uan_ in nn], ury-apx(uat_, uax_, succ(uan_)) == vnb-lambda(uac_, cu-pairs(uat_), num(1/2) * ((ury-apx(uat_, uax_, uan_))(ury-l(uat_, uac_)) + (ury-apx(uat_, uax_, uan_))(ury-r(uat_, uac_)))))

ury-apx-zero

forall([uat_, uax_], ury-apx(uat_, uax_, 0) == vnb-lambda(uac_, cu-pairs(uat_), if(uax_ in nth(2, uac_), 0, 1)))

wks-stage-succ

forall([mcn_ in nn], wks-stage(succ(mcn_)) == vnb-lambda(mce_, expr-stage(succ(mcn_)), if(mce_ in expr-stage(mcn_), (wks-stage(mcn_))(mce_), if(nth(1, mce_) = 3, {mckk_ in nn: mckk_ = hd-res(nth(2, mce_)) and app-ar-ok(nth(2, mce_), length(nth(3, mce_))) and forall([mcw_ in make-set(nth(3, mce_))], hd-argk(nth(2, mce_)) in (wks-stage(mcn_))(mcw_))}, {mckk_ in nn: mckk_ = hd-bres(nth(2, mce_)) and bind-sig(nth(2, mce_), nth(3, mce_), length(nth(4, mce_))) and forall([mcw_ in make-set(nth(4, mce_))], 1 in (wks-stage(mcn_))(mcw_)) and hd-body(nth(2, mce_)) in (wks-stage(mcn_))(nth(5, mce_))}))))

wks-stage-zero

wks-stage(0) == vnb-lambda(mce_, expr-stage(0), pair(1, 1))

zen-limit

forall([x, lam], limit-ord(lam) implies zen(x, lam) == choice({y_ in x: forall([c_ in ord], ord-lt(c_, lam) implies not(zen(x, c_) = y_))}))

zen-succ

forall([x, alpha in ord], zen(x, succ_ord(alpha)) == choice({y_ in x: forall([c_ in ord], ord-le(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(x, c_) = y_))}))

zen-zero

forall([x], zen(x, 0) == choice(x))

zero-ring-def

zero-ring = [{0}, vnb-lambda([p, q], cartesian({0}, {0}), 0), vnb-lambda([p, q], cartesian({0}, {0}), 0), vnb-lambda(p, {0}, 0), 0, 0]

zkept-limit

forall([phi, grd, porel, lam], limit-ord(lam) implies zkept(phi, grd, porel, lam) == big-union(beta, ord-segment(lam), zkept(phi, grd, porel, beta)))

zkept-succ

forall([phi, grd, porel, alpha in ord], zkept(phi, grd, porel, succ_ord(alpha)) == union(zkept(phi, grd, porel, alpha), keep-set(phi, grd, porel, zkept(phi, grd, porel, alpha), alpha)))

zkept-zero

forall([phi, grd, porel], zkept(phi, grd, porel, 0) == empty-set)

zup-limit

forall([grd, porel, lam], limit-ord(lam) implies zup(grd, porel, lam) == choice({y_ in grd: forall([c_ in ord], ord-lt(c_, lam) implies [zup(grd, porel, c_), y_] in porel)}))

zup-succ

forall([grd, porel, alpha in ord], zup(grd, porel, succ_ord(alpha)) == choice({y_ in grd: is-strictly-below(porel, zup(grd, porel, alpha), y_)}))

zup-zero

forall([grd, porel], zup(grd, porel, 0) == choice(grd))

zz-add-monoid-def

zz-add-monoid = [zz, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_), 0]

zz-add-monoid@carr

carr(zz-add-monoid) == zz

zz-add-monoid@iden

iden(zz-add-monoid) == 0

zz-add-monoid@opr

opr(zz-add-monoid) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_)

zz-bezout-set-membership

forall([a, b, z_], z_ in zz-bezout-set(a, b) iff z_ in zz and forsome([x_ in zz, y_ in zz], z_ = x_ * a + y_ * b))

zz-ring-def

zz-ring = [zz, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, zz, -x_), 0, 1]

zz-ring@add

add(zz-ring) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_)

zz-ring@carr

carr(zz-ring) == zz

zz-ring@mul

mul(zz-ring) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ * y_)

zz-ring@neg

neg(zz-ring) == vnb-lambda(x_, zz, -x_)

zz-ring@one

one(zz-ring) == 1

zz-ring@zero

zero(zz-ring) == 0
